source.text: מַשָּׂ֖א מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה רֹכֵ֨ב עַל־עָ֥ב קַל֙ וּבָ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנָע֞וּ אֱלִילֵ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וּלְבַ֥ב מִצְרַ֖יִם יִמַּ֥ס בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: The oracle of Egypt. Look, Yahweh [is] riding on a cloud swift and coming [to] Egypt, and will tremble [the] idols of Egypt before him, and [the] heart of Egypt will melt within it.

en.L: The oracle of Egypt. \q Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is riding on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt, \q and the idols of Egypt will tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and the heart of Egypt will melt within it.
en.B: An oracle about Egypt. \q Look, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is riding a swift cloud, on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} way to Egypt. \q Egypt's idols will shake at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming, \q and Egypt's courage will melt away inside it.
en.R: This is a message about Egypt. \q Look! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is riding on a fast cloud, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming to Egypt. \q The idols of Egypt will shake with fear in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q The people of Egypt will lose all their courage.

es.L: Oráculo sobre Egipto. \q He aquí, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cabalga sobre una nube veloz y viene a Egipto, \q y los ídolos de Egipto temblarán delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y el corazón de Egipto se derretirá dentro de él.
es.B: Oráculo sobre Egipto. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} cabalga sobre una nube veloz, camino de Egipto. \q Los ídolos de Egipto temblarán ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llegada, \q y el valor de Egipto se derretirá dentro de él.
es.R: Este es un mensaje sobre Egipto. \q ¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} viene montado sobre una nube rápida, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene a Egipto. \q Los ídolos de Egipto temblarán de miedo delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q La gente de Egipto perderá todo su valor.

fr.L: Oracle [concernant] l’Égypte. \q Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est monté sur une nuée rapide et vient en Égypte, \q et les idoles de l’Égypte tremblent devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et le cœur de l’Égypte fond au-dedans d’elle.
fr.B: Oracle sur l’Égypte. \q Voici, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est monté sur une nuée rapide, en route vers l’Égypte. \q Les idoles de l’Égypte tremblent à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arrivée, \q et le courage de l’Égypte fond en elle.
fr.R: Message au sujet de l’Égypte. \q Regardez ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} arrive sur un nuage rapide, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient en Égypte. \q Les idoles de l’Égypte tremblent de peur devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Les Égyptiens perdent tout leur courage.

sw.L: Unabii [juu ya] Misri. \q Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amepanda juu ya wingu jepesi na anakuja Misri, \q na sanamu za Misri zitatetemeka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na moyo wa Misri utayeyuka ndani yake.
sw.B: Unabii kuhusu Misri. \q Tazama, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amepanda wingu jepesi, akiwa njiani kwenda Misri. \q Sanamu za Misri zitatetemeka kwa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, \q na ujasiri wa Misri utayeyuka ndani yake.
sw.R: Huu ni ujumbe kuhusu Misri. \q Tazama! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amepanda juu ya wingu linalokwenda kasi, naye anakuja Misri. \q Sanamu za Misri zitatetemeka kwa hofu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Watu wa Misri watapoteza ujasiri wao wote.

vi.L: Sấm ngôn về Ai Cập. \q Kìa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cỡi trên đám mây bay nhanh và đang đến Ai Cập, \q các thần tượng của Ai Cập sẽ run rẩy trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và lòng Ai Cập sẽ tan chảy trong nó.
vi.B: Sấm ngôn về Ai Cập. \q Này, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cỡi đám mây bay nhanh, đang trên đường đến Ai Cập. \q Các thần tượng Ai Cập sẽ run sợ khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến, \q và lòng can đảm của Ai Cập sẽ tan biến.
vi.R: Đây là sứ điệp về Ai Cập. \q Hãy xem! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang cỡi trên một đám mây bay nhanh, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến Ai Cập. \q Các thần tượng của Ai Cập sẽ run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Dân Ai Cập sẽ mất hết can đảm.

ko.L: 이집트에 [관한] 신탁. \q 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 빠른 구름을 타고 이집트로 오고 계시니, \q 이집트의 우상들이 그분 앞에서 떨고, \q 이집트의 마음이 그 속에서 녹을 것이다.
ko.B: 이집트에 관한 신탁. \q 보아라, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 빠른 구름을 타시고 이집트로 오신다. \q 그분께서 오시면 이집트의 우상들이 떨고, \q 이집트 사람들의 용기가 속에서 녹아내릴 것이다.
ko.R: 이것은 이집트에 관한 말씀이다. \q 보아라! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 빠른 구름을 타시고 이집트로 오고 계신다. \q 이집트의 우상들이 그분 앞에서 두려워 떨 것이다. \q 이집트 사람들은 용기를 모두 잃을 것이다.

pt.L: Oráculo [contra] o Egito. \q Eis que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vem montado numa nuvem veloz e está chegando ao Egito, \q e os ídolos do Egito tremerão diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q e o coração do Egito se derreterá dentro dele.
pt.B: Mensagem contra o Egito. \q Vejam, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} cavalga uma nuvem veloz, a caminho do Egito. \q Os ídolos do Egito estremecem com a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} chegada, \q e a coragem do Egito se derrete dentro dele.
pt.R: Esta é uma mensagem contra o Egito. \q Vejam! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vem montado numa nuvem rápida, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vindo para o Egito. \q Os ídolos do Egito vão tremer de medo diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q O povo do Egito vai perder toda a coragem.

am.L: ስለ ግብፅ የትንቢት ቃል። \q እነሆ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በፈጣን ደመና ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ ግብፅ ይመጣል፤ \q የግብፅም ከንቱ ጣዖታት በፊቱ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ \q የግብፅም ልብ በውስጡ ይቀልጣል።
am.B: ስለ ግብፅ የተነገረ የትንቢት ቃል። \q ተመልከቱ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በፈጣን ደመና ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ ግብፅ እየመጣ ነው። \q የግብፅ ከንቱ ጣዖታት በመምጣቱ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ \q የግብፅም ድፍረት በውስጡ ይቀልጣል።
am.R: ይህ ስለ ግብፅ የተነገረ የትንቢት ቃል ነው። \q ተመልከቱ! {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በፈጣን ደመና ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ ግብፅ ይመጣል። \q የግብፅ ጣዖታት በፊቱ በፍርሃት ይንቀጠቀጣሉ። \q የግብፅ ሰዎች ድፍረታቸውን ሁሉ ያጣሉ።

hi.L: मिस्र के विषय में भारी वचन। \q देखो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} एक वेग से चलनेवाले बादल पर सवार होकर मिस्र को आ रहे हैं, \q और मिस्र की मूरतें उनके सामने काँप उठेंगी, \q और मिस्र का हृदय उसके भीतर पिघल जाएगा।
hi.B: मिस्र के विषय में संदेश। \q देखो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} एक तेज़ बादल पर सवार होकर मिस्र की ओर आ रहे हैं। \q उनके आने से मिस्र की मूरतें थरथरा उठेंगी, \q और मिस्र का साहस उसके भीतर पिघल जाएगा।
hi.R: यह मिस्र के बारे में एक संदेश है। \q देखो! {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} एक तेज़ बादल पर सवार हैं, और वे मिस्र आ रहे हैं। \q मिस्र की मूर्तियाँ उनके सामने डर से काँपेंगी। \q मिस्र के लोगों का सारा साहस जाता रहेगा।

ru.L: Пророчество о Египте. \q Вот, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} восседает на быстром облаке и идёт в Египет, \q и затрепещут идолы Египта перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, \q и сердце Египта растает в нём.
ru.B: Пророчество о Египте. \q Вот, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} мчится на быстром облаке, держа путь в Египет. \q Идолы Египта задрожат при {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} приходе, \q и мужество Египта растает в нём.
ru.R: Это весть о Египте. \q Смотрите! {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} мчится на быстром облаке, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} идёт в Египет. \q Идолы Египта задрожат от страха перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. \q Жители Египта совсем падут духом.

ja.L: エジプトについての託宣。 \q 見なさい、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は速い雲に乗ってエジプトに来られる。 \q エジプトの偶像はその方の前で震え、 \q エジプトの心はその内で溶ける。
ja.B: エジプトについての託宣。 \q 見なさい、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は速い雲に乗り、エジプトに向かっておられる。 \q エジプトの偶像は、その方が来られるのを前にして震え、 \q エジプトの勇気はその内で溶け去る。
ja.R: これは、エジプトについての神のお告げ。 \q 見なさい！{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が速い雲に乗って、エジプトに来られる。 \q エジプトの偶像は、その方の前で恐れて震える。 \q エジプトの人々は、すっかり勇気をなくす。

decisions.choice: oracle: a solemn message from God, here about a nation
decisions.reason: The word is from the verb "lift up" and heads each message about a nation in chapters 13-23 (see the note at 13:1). It may mean a message lifted up by the voice, or a burden laid on the hearer.

decisions.choice: riding on a swift cloud: God comes as the warrior who rides the clouds
decisions.reason: God is pictured riding on the clouds or the wind in Deuteronomy 33:26, Psalm 18:11 and Psalm 104:3. Here he comes swiftly to judge Egypt.

decisions.choice: the idols of Egypt will tremble: Egypt's gods are powerless before him
decisions.reason: At the exodus God said he would bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt (Exodus 12:12). The word for idols is the one Isaiah uses for worthless gods (2:8, 18, 20).

decisions.choice: message
decisions.reason: Readable says "message" for "oracle", a word many young readers do not know, as at 13:1.

decisions.choice: courage will melt away / lose all their courage
decisions.reason: A melting heart is an idiom for losing courage (Joshua 2:11; 7:5). Balanced says "courage"; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: Oráculo [contra] o Egito (L); Mensagem contra o Egito (B); Esta é uma mensagem contra o Egito (R)
decisions.reason: The heading formula of 13:1, repeated word for word. "Contra" stands here too, although the oracle ends in blessing (verses 18-25): the heading names the word that comes upon Egypt, and its first half is judgment.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Isaiah 19.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns and verb forms for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: idols (ʾelilim) as "ከንቱ ጣዖታት"
decisions.reason: As the prophets' terms list and 10:10; the word mocks the gods as nothings (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: भारी वचन (L); संदेश (B, R); मिस्र
decisions.reason: Massa has the same forms as the heading of 13:1; Egypt is मिस्र, as the Pentateuch note settles.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters for God's pronouns: God spoken of takes honorific plural forms (वे, उनके सामने), and God speaking says मैं (verses 2-4), so the English deity_pronoun setting has no Hindi span in this chapter.

decisions.choice: "Пророчество о Египте" (L, B), "весть о Египте" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading takes the prophets note's wording for massa, as in each oracle of chapters 13-19.

decisions.choice: massa' Mitsrayim "エジプトについての託宣" (L, B), "エジプトについての神のお告げ" (R), the heading form of 15:1, even where the English L says "of Egypt"; 'elilim "偶像" (every level).
decisions.reason: One heading form for every massa' in Isaiah; the construct means the oracle is about Egypt (m1).

decisions.choice: God riding the cloud: "乗って……来られる" (L, R), "向かっておられる" (B), the light respect forms for God's acts in the third person; "その方" for "him".
decisions.reason: The Isaiah conventions; the deity_pronoun spans have no Japanese span.

source.text: וְסִכְסַכְתִּ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִלְחֲמ֥וּ אִישׁ־בְּאָחִ֖יו וְאִ֣ישׁ בְּרֵעֵ֑הוּ עִ֣יר בְּעִ֔יר מַמְלָכָ֖ה בְּמַמְלָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will stir up Egypt against Egypt, and they will fight, each against his brother and each against his neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

en.L: And I will stir up Egypt against Egypt, \q and they will fight, each against his brother and each against his neighbor, \q city against city, kingdom against kingdom.
en.B: I will set Egyptians against Egyptians. \q They will fight one another, brother with brother and neighbor with neighbor, \q city with city and kingdom with kingdom.
en.R: I will make the people of Egypt turn against each other. \q Brothers and neighbors will fight each other. \q Cities and kingdoms will go to war against each other.

es.L: Y incitaré a egipcios contra egipcios, \q y pelearán, cada uno contra su hermano y cada uno contra su prójimo, \q ciudad contra ciudad, reino contra reino.
es.B: Pondré a los egipcios contra los egipcios. \q Pelearán unos contra otros, hermano contra hermano y vecino contra vecino, \q ciudad contra ciudad y reino contra reino.
es.R: Haré que la gente de Egipto se vuelva unos contra otros. \q Hermanos y vecinos pelearán entre sí. \q Ciudades y reinos se harán la guerra unos a otros.

fr.L: Et j’exciterai l’Égypte contre l’Égypte, \q et ils combattront, chacun contre son frère et chacun contre son prochain, \q ville contre ville, royaume contre royaume.
fr.B: Je dresserai les Égyptiens contre les Égyptiens. \q Ils se battront entre eux, le frère contre le frère et le voisin contre le voisin, \q la ville contre la ville et le royaume contre le royaume.
fr.R: Je ferai en sorte que les Égyptiens se tournent les uns contre les autres. \q Frères et voisins se battront entre eux. \q Les villes et les royaumes se feront la guerre.

sw.L: Nami nitawachochea Wamisri juu ya Wamisri, \q nao watapigana, kila mtu na ndugu yake na kila mtu na jirani yake, \q mji na mji, ufalme na ufalme.
sw.B: Nitawaweka Wamisri dhidi ya Wamisri. \q Watapigana wao kwa wao, ndugu na ndugu na jirani na jirani, \q mji na mji na ufalme na ufalme.
sw.R: Nitawafanya watu wa Misri wageukane. \q Ndugu na majirani watapigana wao kwa wao. \q Miji na falme zitapigana vita wao kwa wao.

vi.L: Ta sẽ khích động Ai Cập nghịch cùng Ai Cập, \q và chúng sẽ đánh nhau, người này nghịch anh em mình, người kia nghịch người lân cận mình, \q thành này nghịch thành kia, vương quốc này nghịch vương quốc kia.
vi.B: Ta sẽ xui người Ai Cập chống lại người Ai Cập. \q Chúng sẽ đánh nhau, anh em đánh anh em, láng giềng đánh láng giềng, \q thành đánh thành, vương quốc đánh vương quốc.
vi.R: Ta sẽ khiến dân Ai Cập quay ra chống lại nhau. \q Anh em và láng giềng sẽ đánh nhau. \q Các thành và các vương quốc sẽ gây chiến với nhau.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 이집트를 부추겨 이집트를 치게 할 것이니, \q 그들이 서로 싸울 것이다. 각 사람이 자기 형제와, 각 사람이 자기 이웃과, \q 성읍이 성읍과, 나라가 나라와 [싸울 것이다].
ko.B: 내가 이집트 사람들을 부추겨 서로 맞서게 하겠다. \q 그들이 형제끼리, 이웃끼리 싸우고, \q 성읍끼리, 나라끼리 싸울 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 이집트 사람들이 서로 등을 돌리게 하겠다. \q 형제와 이웃이 서로 싸울 것이다. \q 성읍과 나라들이 서로 전쟁을 할 것이다.

pt.L: E incitarei o Egito contra o Egito, \q e lutarão, cada um contra o seu irmão e cada um contra o seu próximo, \q cidade contra cidade, reino contra reino.
pt.B: Jogarei egípcios contra egípcios. \q Lutarão uns contra os outros, irmão contra irmão e vizinho contra vizinho, \q cidade contra cidade e reino contra reino.
pt.R: Vou fazer o povo do Egito se voltar uns contra os outros. \q Irmãos e vizinhos vão brigar entre si. \q Cidades e reinos vão entrar em guerra uns contra os outros.

am.L: ግብፅን በግብፅ ላይ አነሣሣለሁ፤ \q እያንዳንዱም ከወንድሙ ጋር፣ እያንዳንዱም ከባልንጀራው ጋር ይዋጋሉ፤ \q ከተማ ከከተማ፣ መንግሥትም ከመንግሥት ጋር።
am.B: ግብፃውያንን እርስ በርሳቸው አጋጫቸዋለሁ፤ \q ወንድም ከወንድሙ፣ ጎረቤትም ከጎረቤቱ ጋር ይዋጋል፤ \q ከተማ ከከተማ፣ መንግሥትም ከመንግሥት ጋር ይዋጋል።
am.R: የግብፅ ሰዎች እርስ በርሳቸው እንዲጣሉ አደርጋለሁ። \q ወንድሞችና ጎረቤቶች እርስ በርሳቸው ይዋጋሉ። \q ከተሞችና መንግሥታት እርስ በርሳቸው ይዋጋሉ።

hi.L: और मैं मिस्र को मिस्र के विरुद्ध उभारूँगा, \q और वे लड़ेंगे, हर एक अपने भाई से और हर एक अपने पड़ोसी से, \q नगर नगर से, राज्य राज्य से।
hi.B: मैं मिस्रियों को मिस्रियों के विरुद्ध खड़ा कर दूँगा। \q वे आपस में लड़ेंगे, भाई भाई से और पड़ोसी पड़ोसी से, \q नगर नगर से और राज्य राज्य से।
hi.R: मैं मिस्र के लोगों को एक-दूसरे के विरुद्ध कर दूँगा। \q भाई और पड़ोसी आपस में लड़ेंगे। \q नगर और राज्य एक-दूसरे से युद्ध करेंगे।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} подниму египтян против египтян, \q и будут они воевать — каждый против брата своего и каждый против ближнего своего, \q город против города, царство против царства.
ru.B: Я восстановлю египтян против египтян. \q Они будут воевать друг с другом — брат с братом и сосед с соседом, \q город с городом и царство с царством.
ru.R: Я сделаю так, что жители Египта восстанут друг против друга. \q Братья и соседи будут драться между собой. \q Города и царства будут воевать друг с другом.

ja.L: そして、わたしはエジプトをエジプトに逆らわせて奮い立たせる。 \q 彼らは戦う。人はその兄弟と、人はその隣人と、 \q 町は町と、王国は王国と。
ja.B: わたしは、エジプト人をエジプト人と争わせる。 \q 彼らは互いに戦い、兄弟は兄弟と、隣人は隣人と、 \q 町は町と、王国は王国と戦う。
ja.R: わたしは、エジプトの人々を互いに争わせる。 \q 兄弟どうし、隣の人どうしが戦う。 \q 町と町、国と国が、互いに戦う。

decisions.choice: stir up: provoke, set one against another
decisions.reason: The verb means to goad or incite. The same word is used of God stirring up Rezin's enemies in 9:10.

decisions.choice: kingdom against kingdom: Egypt torn between rival rulers
decisions.reason: In the eighth century BC Egypt was not one united kingdom but was divided among several rival rulers, until kings from Cush took control of the whole land.

decisions.choice: God speaks in the first person within the oracle, plain, "わたし", with no quotation mark, as the English.
decisions.reason: The Isaiah conventions for God's speech inside an oracle.

source.text: וְנָבְקָ֤ה רֽוּחַ־מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּקִרְבּ֔וֹ וַעֲצָת֖וֹ אֲבַלֵּ֑עַ וְדָרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל־הָֽאֱלִילִים֙ וְאֶל־הָ֣אִטִּ֔ים וְאֶל־הָאֹב֖וֹת וְאֶל־הַיִּדְּעֹנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be emptied [the] spirit of Egypt within it, and its counsel I will swallow up, and they will seek to the idols and to the ghosts and to the mediums and to the knowing ones.

en.L: And the spirit of Egypt will be emptied out within it, \q and its counsel I will swallow up, \q and they will seek the idols and the ghosts \q and the mediums and the spiritists.
en.B: Egypt's spirit will drain away within it, \q and I will throw its plans into confusion. \q They will turn for answers to idols and ghosts, \q to mediums and to those who consult spirits.
en.R: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will ruin their plans. \q They will ask their idols for advice. \q They will turn to ghosts and to people who claim to speak with the dead.

es.L: Y el espíritu de Egipto se vaciará dentro de él, \q y su consejo destruiré, \q y consultarán a los ídolos y a los espíritus de los muertos, \q y a los médiums y a los adivinos.
es.B: El espíritu de Egipto se agotará dentro de él, \q y echaré a perder sus planes. \q Buscarán respuestas en los ídolos y en los espíritus de los muertos, \q en los médiums y en los que consultan a los espíritus.
es.R: Los egipcios se desanimarán, y yo arruinaré sus planes. \q Pedirán consejo a sus ídolos. \q Acudirán a los espíritus de los muertos y a la gente que dice que habla con los muertos.

fr.L: Et l’esprit de l’Égypte sera vidé au-dedans d’elle, \q et son conseil, je l’engloutirai, \q et ils consulteront les idoles et les revenants, \q et les nécromanciens et les devins.
fr.B: Le courage de l’Égypte s’épuisera en elle, \q et je réduirai ses projets à néant. \q Ils iront demander des réponses aux idoles et aux revenants, \q aux nécromanciens et à ceux qui consultent les esprits.
fr.R: Les Égyptiens perdront courage, et je ferai échouer leurs projets. \q Ils demanderont conseil à leurs idoles. \q Ils se tourneront vers les esprits des morts et vers les gens qui prétendent parler avec les morts.

sw.L: Na roho ya Misri itamwagika ndani yake, \q na shauri lake nitalimeza, \q nao watatafuta sanamu na mizimu \q na wapunga pepo na wachawi.
sw.B: Roho ya Misri itamalizika ndani yake, \q nami nitaivuruga mipango yake. \q Watazigeukia sanamu na mizimu kutafuta majibu, \q watawaendea wapunga pepo na wanaoshauriana na roho.
sw.R: Wamisri watakata tamaa, nami nitaiharibu mipango yao. \q Wataziomba sanamu zao ushauri. \q Watazigeukia roho za wafu na watu wanaodai kwamba wanaongea na wafu.

vi.L: Tinh thần của Ai Cập sẽ bị trút cạn trong nó, \q và mưu kế của nó Ta sẽ làm tiêu tan; \q chúng sẽ cầu hỏi các thần tượng và các hồn ma, \q các đồng bóng và các thầy chiêu hồn.
vi.B: Tinh thần của Ai Cập sẽ tiêu hao trong nó, \q và Ta sẽ làm cho mưu kế của nó rối loạn. \q Chúng sẽ đi cầu hỏi các thần tượng và các hồn ma, \q các đồng bóng và những kẻ chiêu hồn.
vi.R: Dân Ai Cập sẽ mất tinh thần, và Ta sẽ phá hỏng các kế hoạch của họ. \q Họ sẽ xin các thần tượng chỉ bảo. \q Họ sẽ tìm đến các hồn ma và những kẻ tự nhận có thể nói chuyện với người chết.

ko.L: 그리고 이집트의 영이 그 속에서 비워지고, \q 내가 그 계략을 삼켜 버릴 것이니, \q 그들이 우상들과 혼백들과 \q 신접한 자들과 점쟁이들에게 물을 것이다.
ko.B: 이집트 사람들은 속에서 넋이 빠지고, \q 내가 그들의 계획을 뒤죽박죽으로 만들 것이다. \q 그들은 우상과 혼백에게 답을 구하고, \q 신접한 자와 점쟁이를 찾아갈 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트 사람들은 낙심할 것이다. 내가 그들의 계획을 망쳐 놓겠다. \q 그들은 우상들에게 조언을 구할 것이다. \q 그들은 혼백과, 죽은 사람과 이야기할 수 있다고 말하는 사람들을 찾아갈 것이다.

pt.L: E o espírito do Egito se esvaziará dentro dele, \q e o seu conselho eu tragarei; \q e consultarão os ídolos e os espíritos dos mortos \q e os médiuns e os adivinhos.
pt.B: O ânimo do Egito se esgotará dentro dele, \q e eu confundirei os seus planos. \q Eles buscarão respostas nos ídolos e nos espíritos dos mortos, \q nos médiuns e nos que consultam espíritos.
pt.R: Os egípcios vão perder o ânimo, e eu vou arruinar os seus planos. \q Vão pedir conselho aos seus ídolos. \q Vão procurar os espíritos dos mortos e as pessoas que dizem falar com os mortos.

am.L: የግብፅም መንፈስ በውስጡ ባዶ ይሆናል፤ \q ምክሩንም እውጣለሁ፤ \q ከንቱ ጣዖታትንና የሙታንን መናፍስት፣ \q ሙታን ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም ይጠይቃሉ።
am.B: የግብፅ መንፈስ በውስጡ ይሟጠጣል፤ \q ዕቅዱንም አደበላልቃለሁ። \q መልስ ለማግኘት ከንቱ ጣዖታትንና የሙታንን መናፍስት፣ \q ሙታን ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችን ይጠይቃሉ።
am.R: ግብፃውያን ተስፋ ይቆርጣሉ፤ እኔም ዕቅዳቸውን አበላሻለሁ። \q ጣዖቶቻቸውን ምክር ይጠይቃሉ። \q ወደ ሙታን መናፍስትና ከሙታን ጋር እንነጋገራለን ወደሚሉ ሰዎች ይሄዳሉ።

hi.L: और मिस्र का आत्मा उसके भीतर ख़ाली हो जाएगा, \q और मैं उसकी युक्ति को निगल जाऊँगा; \q और वे मूरतों और प्रेतों \q और ओझों और भूत साधनेवालों से पूछेंगे।
hi.B: मिस्र का मन उसके भीतर ही टूट जाएगा, \q और मैं उसकी योजनाओं को उलझा दूँगा। \q वे उत्तर के लिए मूरतों और प्रेतों की ओर, \q ओझों और भूत साधनेवालों की ओर फिरेंगे।
hi.R: मिस्री हिम्मत हार जाएँगे, और मैं उनकी योजनाओं को बिगाड़ दूँगा। \q वे अपनी मूर्तियों से सलाह माँगेंगे। \q वे प्रेतों के पास और उन लोगों के पास जाएँगे जो कहते हैं कि वे मरे हुओं से बात करते हैं।

ru.L: И опустеет дух Египта внутри него, \q и замысел его {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} поглощу, \q и будут они обращаться к идолам и к духам умерших, \q и к вызывателям мёртвых, и к ведунам.
ru.B: Дух Египта иссякнет в нём, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приведу его замыслы в смятение. \q Они будут искать ответа у идолов и духов умерших, \q у вызывателей мёртвых и у тех, кто советуется с духами.
ru.R: Египтяне падут духом, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} разрушу их замыслы. \q Они будут просить совета у своих идолов. \q Они будут обращаться к духам умерших и к людям, которые говорят, что могут разговаривать с мёртвыми.

ja.L: そして、エジプトの霊はその内で空しくされ、 \q わたしはそのはかりごとを飲み尽くす。 \q 彼らは偶像と死霊に、 \q 口寄せと霊媒に伺いを立てる。
ja.B: エジプトの気力はその内で尽き果て、 \q わたしはその計画を混乱させる。 \q 彼らは偶像や死霊に、 \q 口寄せや霊媒に答えを求める。
ja.R: エジプトの人々は元気をなくし、わたしは彼らの計画をだめにする。 \q 彼らは自分たちの偶像に助言を求める。 \q 死んだ人の霊や、死んだ人と話せると言う者たちに頼る。

decisions.choice: emptied ... swallow up: Egypt's courage drains away and its plans come to nothing
decisions.reason: The first verb means to empty out, as a jar is emptied (24:1, 3). The second, "swallow up", is used for confusing or bringing plans to nothing (3:12; 28:7). Egypt was famous for its wisdom (verse 11; 1 Kings 5:10), and its wisdom will fail.

decisions.choice: ghosts: the spirits of the dead consulted for answers
decisions.reason: This word is found only here. It is probably related to an Akkadian word for the spirit of a dead person, and it stands in a list of those who consult the dead.

decisions.choice: mediums and spiritists: people who claim to call up the dead
decisions.reason: The same pair is forbidden in Leviticus 19:31 and Deuteronomy 18:11, and Isaiah warned Judah against them in 8:19.

decisions.choice: The Egyptians will lose heart ... their plans
decisions.reason: Readable names the people for "the spirit of Egypt" and "its counsel".

decisions.choice: mediums (ʾovot) "ሙታን ጠሪዎች" and spiritists (yiddeʿonim) "ጠንቋዮች", as Leviticus 19:31; ghosts (ʾittim) "የሙታን መናፍስት"
decisions.reason: The words of the law against consulting the dead keep the Amharic of Leviticus on main; ʾittim, found only here, are the spirits of the dead (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: मूरतें, प्रेत, ओझे, भूत साधनेवाले
decisions.reason: The mediums and spiritists keep the forms of 1 Samuel 28:3 in this translation; the ghosts (the spirits of the dead consulted, m2) are प्रेत.

decisions.choice: "духам умерших", "вызывателям мёртвых", "ведунам" (L); "тем, кто советуется с духами" (B)
decisions.reason: The words for mediums and spiritists take the forms of 1 Samuel 28:3 ("вызыватели мёртвых и ведуны"); Readable explains them as Leviticus 19:31 does.

decisions.choice: darash "伺いを立てる" (L), "答えを求める" (B); 'ittim "死霊" (L, B), 'ovot "口寄せ", yidde'onim "霊媒" (L, B), Readable "死んだ人の霊 / 死んだ人と話せると言う者たち", as ISA 8:19 and 2 Kings 21:6.
decisions.reason: The forms the Isaiah and Kings notes give; 'ittim occurs only here and is read as the spirits of the dead (m2, uncertain).

source.text: וְסִכַּרְתִּי֙ אֶת־מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּיַ֖ד אֲדֹנִ֣ים קָשֶׁ֑ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ עַז֙ יִמְשָׁל־בָּ֔ם נְאֻ֥ם הָאָד֖וֹן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will hand over Egypt into [the] hand of masters hard, and a king fierce will rule over them, [the] declaration of the Lord, Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And I will hand over Egypt into the hand of a hard master, \q and a fierce king will rule over them, \q declares the Lord, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: I will give Egypt into the grip of a hard master; \q a strong king will reign over them, \q declares the Lord, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: I will put Egypt under the control of a cruel ruler. \q A powerful king will rule over them, \q says the Lord, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: Y entregaré a Egipto en mano de un amo duro, \q y un rey cruel gobernará sobre ellos, \q declara el Señor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Entregaré a Egipto en manos de un amo cruel; \q un rey fuerte reinará sobre ellos, \q afirma el Señor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Pondré a Egipto bajo el control de un gobernante cruel. \q Un rey poderoso gobernará sobre ellos, \q dice el Señor, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Et je livrerai l’Égypte aux mains d’un maître dur, \q et un roi cruel dominera sur eux, \q déclare le Seigneur, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Je livrerai l’Égypte à la poigne d’un maître impitoyable ; \q un roi puissant régnera sur eux, \q déclare le Seigneur, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Je mettrai l’Égypte sous le pouvoir d’un chef cruel. \q Un roi puissant régnera sur eux, \q dit le Seigneur, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Nami nitawatia Wamisri mkononi mwa bwana mgumu, \q na mfalme mkali atawatawala, \q asema Bwana, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Nitawatia Wamisri katika mshiko wa bwana mgumu; \q mfalme mwenye nguvu atawatawala, \q asema Bwana, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Nitaiweka Misri chini ya mamlaka ya mtawala mkatili. \q Mfalme mwenye nguvu atawatawala, \q anasema Bwana, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Ta sẽ phó Ai Cập vào tay một chủ hà khắc, \q và một vua hung bạo sẽ cai trị chúng, \q Chúa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trao Ai Cập vào tay một chủ nhân hà khắc; \q một vua hùng mạnh sẽ cai trị chúng, \q Chúa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đặt Ai Cập dưới quyền của một kẻ cai trị tàn ác. \q Một vua đầy quyền lực sẽ cai trị họ, \q Chúa, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, phán.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 이집트를 가혹한 주인의 손에 넘길 것이니, \q 사나운 왕이 그들을 다스릴 것이다. \q 주님, 곧 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 이집트를 가혹한 주인의 손아귀에 넘겨주겠다. \q 강한 왕이 그들을 다스릴 것이다. \q 주님, 곧 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 이집트를 잔인한 통치자의 손에 넘기겠다. \q 힘센 왕이 그들을 다스릴 것이다. \q 주님, 곧 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E entregarei o Egito na mão de um senhor duro, \q e um rei feroz dominará sobre eles, \q declara o Senhor, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Entregarei o Egito nas garras de um senhor cruel; \q um rei poderoso reinará sobre eles, \q declara o Senhor, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Vou pôr o Egito sob o domínio de um governante cruel. \q Um rei poderoso vai governá-los, \q diz o Senhor, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos.

am.L: ግብፅንም በጨካኝ ጌታ እጅ አሳልፌ እሰጣለሁ፤ \q ብርቱ ንጉሥም ይገዛቸዋል፤ \q ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት።
am.B: ግብፅን በጨካኝ ጌታ መዳፍ ውስጥ እሰጣለሁ፤ \q ብርቱ ንጉሥ ይነግሥባቸዋል፤ \q ይላል ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: ግብፅን በጨካኝ ገዥ ሥር አደርጋታለሁ። \q ኃይለኛ ንጉሥ ይገዛቸዋል፤ \q ይላል ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: और मैं मिस्र को एक कठोर स्वामी के हाथ में कर दूँगा, \q और एक क्रूर राजा उन पर राज्य करेगा, \q प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: मैं मिस्र को एक कठोर स्वामी की पकड़ में सौंप दूँगा; \q एक बलवान राजा उन पर राज्य करेगा, \q प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: मैं मिस्र को एक निर्दयी शासक के अधीन कर दूँगा। \q एक शक्तिशाली राजा उन पर राज्य करेगा, \q प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} предам Египет в руку господина жестокого, \q и царь свирепый будет властвовать над ними, \q — слово Владыки, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа.
ru.B: Я отдам Египет во власть сурового господина; \q могучий царь будет царствовать над ними, \q говорит Владыка, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф.
ru.R: Я отдам Египет под власть жестокого правителя. \q Могущественный царь будет править ими, \q говорит Владыка, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств.

ja.L: そして、わたしはエジプトを厳しい主人の手に引き渡す。 \q 猛々しい王が彼らを治める。 \q ――主、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――
ja.B: わたしはエジプトを、厳しい主人の手に渡す。 \q 力ある王が彼らを治める、 \q と主、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: わたしは、エジプトを残酷な支配者の手にまかせる。 \q 強い王が彼らを治める、 \q と主、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。

decisions.choice: a hard master: one ruler
decisions.reason: The noun is plural in form but has a singular adjective, as the word for "master" often does when it means one person of rank. The next line speaks of one king.

decisions.choice: a fierce king: a foreign ruler over Egypt
decisions.reason: The king is not named. Egypt was later ruled by kings from Cush, and then conquered by the Assyrian king Esarhaddon in 671 BC. The verse may point to either.

decisions.choice: the Lord: the Master, a title
decisions.reason: The word with the article means "the Master". The same title is joined to the name in 1:24 and 3:1. The ruler God sends is a "master" too, but he serves the true Master.

decisions.choice: "주님, 곧 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}"
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew has the article, "the Lord", followed by "Yahweh of hosts" (meaning decision m3); Korean keeps the title "주님" apart, as the English does, rather than the compound form "주 하나님".

decisions.choice: प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 10:16 and 10:33 ("the Lord, YHWH of hosts"), so the Hindi is the same as there: after प्रभु (Adonai) the name takes परमेश्वर as its default, as Psalm 69:7, so प्रभु is not said twice. The English writes "the LORD" here and "GOD" there; the setting shows the name either way.

decisions.choice: ne'um ha'adon YHWH tseva'ot: "――主、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――" (L), "と主、万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる" (B), "と主、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う" (R); ha'adon "主" with no span (m3), as the English "the Lord".
decisions.reason: The Isaiah formula conventions; the English keeps the title and the name apart, and so does the Japanese.

source.text: וְנִשְּׁתוּ־מַ֖יִם מֵֽהַיָּ֑ם וְנָהָ֖ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְיָבֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be dried up [the] waters from the sea, and [the] river will be parched and dry.

en.L: And the waters will be dried up from the sea, \q and the river will be parched and dry.
en.B: The water will drain from the sea, \q and the river will shrink and run dry.
en.R: The water in the Nile will disappear. \q The river will become completely dry.

es.L: Y se secarán las aguas del mar, \q y el río se agotará y se secará.
es.B: El agua se retirará del mar, \q y el río menguará y se secará.
es.R: El agua del Nilo desaparecerá. \q El río se secará por completo.

fr.L: Et les eaux de la mer tariront, \q et le fleuve sera desséché et à sec.
fr.B: L’eau disparaîtra de la mer, \q et le fleuve baissera jusqu’à être à sec.
fr.R: L’eau du Nil disparaîtra. \q Le fleuve sera complètement à sec.

sw.L: Na maji yatakaushwa kutoka baharini, \q na mto utakauka na kuwa mkavu.
sw.B: Maji yatapungua baharini, \q na mto utapungua na kukauka.
sw.R: Maji ya mto Naili yatatoweka. \q Mto huo utakauka kabisa.

vi.L: Nước biển sẽ cạn đi, \q và sông sẽ khô kiệt và khô cạn.
vi.B: Nước sẽ rút khỏi biển, \q và dòng sông sẽ cạn dần rồi khô hẳn.
vi.R: Nước sông Nin sẽ biến mất. \q Dòng sông sẽ hoàn toàn khô cạn.

ko.L: 그리고 바다에서 물이 마르고, \q 강이 말라 바닥을 드러낼 것이다.
ko.B: 바다의 물이 줄어들고, \q 강물이 줄어들어 말라 버릴 것이다.
ko.R: 나일 강의 물이 없어질 것이다. \q 그 강이 완전히 말라 버릴 것이다.

pt.L: E as águas do mar secarão, \q e o rio se esgotará e secará.
pt.B: A água do mar vai baixar, \q e o rio vai minguar e secar.
pt.R: A água do Nilo vai desaparecer. \q O rio vai ficar completamente seco.

am.L: ውኆችም ከባሕሩ ይደርቃሉ፤ \q ወንዙም ይጠፋል፤ ይደርቃልም።
am.B: ውኃው ከባሕሩ ይጎድላል፤ \q ወንዙም ጎድሎ ይደርቃል።
am.R: የዓባይ ወንዝ ውኃ ይጠፋል። \q ወንዙ ፈጽሞ ይደርቃል።

hi.L: और समुद्र का जल सूख जाएगा, \q और नदी झुलसकर सूख जाएगी।
hi.B: समुद्र का पानी उतर जाएगा, \q और नदी घटते-घटते सूख जाएगी।
hi.R: नील नदी का पानी ग़ायब हो जाएगा। \q नदी पूरी तरह सूख जाएगी।

ru.L: И иссякнут воды в море, \q и река обмелеет и высохнет.
ru.B: Вода уйдёт из моря, \q и река обмелеет и пересохнет.
ru.R: Вода в Ниле исчезнет. \q Река совсем пересохнет.

ja.L: そして、海から水は干上がり、 \q 川は涸れて乾く。
ja.B: 海から水は引き、 \q 川は細って干上がる。
ja.R: ナイル川の水はなくなる。 \q 川はすっかり干上がる。

decisions.choice: the sea ... the river: the Nile
decisions.reason: Egypt's life depended on the Nile, and "sea" is used of the Nile in Nahum 3:8 and Isaiah 18:2. The second line, "the river", says the same thing again.

decisions.choice: parched and dry: two verbs for one complete drying
decisions.reason: Two verbs that mean nearly the same thing are joined to say that the river will dry up entirely.

decisions.choice: the Nile
decisions.reason: Readable names the Nile for "the sea" so that the reader knows which water is meant.

decisions.choice: "mto Naili" for the Nile
decisions.reason: The usual Swahili name of the river; Literal and Balanced keep "the sea" and "the river" where the Hebrew does, and Readable names it, as the English Readable does (m1).

decisions.choice: "sông Nin" (R)
decisions.reason: The common Vietnamese name of the Nile; Literal and Balanced keep "the sea" and "the river" as the Hebrew does, and Readable names the river, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the Nile as "ወንዙ" (L), "ዓባይ" (B, R) through verses 5-8
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list: Literal keeps the Hebrew "the river" (yeʾor), Balanced and Readable name the Nile, "ዓባይ", as Amharic does.

decisions.choice: नील नदी
decisions.reason: "The sea" and "the river" here are the Nile (m1); Readable names it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: yam / nahar "海 / 川" (L, B), both the Nile (m1); Readable "ナイル川" as the English R.
decisions.reason: The poetic names stay at the formal levels; Readable names the river, as the English does.

source.text: וְהֶאֶזְנִ֣יחוּ נְהָר֔וֹת דָּלֲל֥וּ וְחָרְב֖וּ יְאֹרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר קָנֶ֥ה וָס֖וּף קָמֵֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will stink, [the] rivers; they will be low and they will dry up, [the] Nile channels of Matsor; reed and rush will wither.

en.L: And the rivers will stink; \q the Nile channels of Egypt will dwindle and dry up; \q reed and rush will wither.
en.B: The canals will reek, \q the branches of the Nile in Egypt will run low and dry up, \q and the reeds and rushes will waste away.
en.R: The canals will smell rotten. \q The streams of the Nile will get low and dry up. \q The reeds and rushes will die.

es.L: Y los ríos apestarán; \q los canales del Nilo de Egipto menguarán y se secarán; \q la caña y el junco se marchitarán.
es.B: Los canales apestarán, \q los brazos del Nilo en Egipto bajarán y se secarán, \q y las cañas y los juncos se consumirán.
es.R: Los canales olerán a podrido. \q Los brazos del Nilo bajarán y se secarán. \q Las cañas y los juncos se morirán.

fr.L: Et les canaux deviendront puants ; \q les bras du Nil de l’Égypte baisseront et se dessécheront ; \q le roseau et le jonc se flétriront.
fr.B: Les canaux empesteront, \q les bras du Nil en Égypte baisseront et tariront, \q et les roseaux et les joncs dépériront.
fr.R: Les canaux sentiront la pourriture. \q Les bras du Nil baisseront et seront à sec. \q Les roseaux et les joncs mourront.

sw.L: Na mito itanuka; \q mifereji ya Naili ya Misri itapungua na kukauka; \q mianzi na matete yatanyauka.
sw.B: Mifereji itanuka vibaya, \q matawi ya mto Naili katika Misri yatapungua na kukauka, \q na mianzi na matete yatadhoofika.
sw.R: Mifereji itanuka uozo. \q Vijito vya mto Naili vitapungua na kukauka. \q Mianzi na matete yatakufa.

vi.L: Các sông sẽ hôi thối; \q các nhánh sông Nin của Ai Cập sẽ cạn dần và khô đi; \q sậy và lác sẽ héo tàn.
vi.B: Các kênh đào sẽ bốc mùi hôi thối, \q các nhánh sông Nin của Ai Cập sẽ cạn dần và khô hẳn, \q và sậy lác sẽ héo úa.
vi.R: Các con kênh sẽ hôi thối. \q Các dòng suối của sông Nin sẽ cạn dần và khô đi. \q Sậy và lác sẽ chết.

ko.L: 그리고 강들이 악취를 풍기고, \q 이집트의 나일 지류들이 줄어들어 마르며, \q 갈대와 부들이 시들 것이다.
ko.B: 운하마다 썩은 냄새가 나고, \q 이집트의 나일 강 지류들이 줄어들어 말라 버리며, \q 갈대와 부들이 시들어 버릴 것이다.
ko.R: 운하에서는 썩은 냄새가 날 것이다. \q 나일 강의 지류들이 줄어들어 말라 버릴 것이다. \q 갈대와 부들도 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: E os rios cheirarão mal; \q os canais do Nilo do Egito diminuirão e secarão; \q a cana e o junco murcharão.
pt.B: Os canais vão feder, \q os braços do Nilo no Egito vão baixar e secar, \q e as canas e os juncos vão definhar.
pt.R: Os canais vão ficar com cheiro de podre. \q Os riachos do Nilo vão baixar e secar. \q As canas e os juncos vão morrer.

am.L: ወንዞቹም ይገማሉ፤ \q የግብፅ የወንዝ መስኖዎች ይጎድላሉ፤ ይደርቃሉም፤ \q ሸምበቆና ደንገል ይጠወልጋሉ።
am.B: መስኖዎቹ ይገማሉ፤ \q በግብፅ ያሉት የዓባይ ቅርንጫፎች ይጎድላሉ፤ ይደርቃሉም፤ \q ሸምበቆውና ደንገሉ ይጠወልጋሉ።
am.R: መስኖዎቹ ይበሰብሳሉ፤ መጥፎ ሽታም ይሸታሉ። \q የዓባይ ጅረቶች ጎድለው ይደርቃሉ። \q ሸምበቆና ደንገል ይሞታሉ።

hi.L: और नहरें सड़ जाएँगी; \q मिस्र की नील की धाराएँ घटकर सूख जाएँगी; \q सरकंडे और नरकट मुरझा जाएँगे।
hi.B: नहरों से दुर्गंध उठेगी, \q मिस्र में नील की शाखाएँ घटकर सूख जाएँगी, \q और सरकंडे और नरकट सूखकर मिट जाएँगे।
hi.R: नहरों से सड़ी हुई बदबू आएगी। \q नील नदी की धाराएँ घटकर सूख जाएँगी। \q सरकंडे और नरकट मर जाएँगे।

ru.L: И засмердят реки; \q обмелеют и высохнут нильские протоки Египта; \q тростник и камыш завянут.
ru.B: Каналы будут смердеть, \q рукава Нила в Египте обмелеют и пересохнут, \q и тростник с камышом зачахнут.
ru.R: Каналы будут гнило пахнуть. \q Протоки Нила обмелеют и пересохнут. \q Тростник и камыш погибнут.

ja.L: そして、川々は悪臭を放ち、 \q エジプトのナイルの支流は細って干上がり、 \q 葦とい草は枯れる。
ja.B: 運河は悪臭を放ち、 \q エジプトのナイルの支流は水かさが減って干上がり、 \q 葦もい草も枯れ果てる。
ja.R: 運河は、ひどいにおいがする。 \q ナイル川の流れは浅くなり、干上がる。 \q 葦や草は枯れてしまう。

decisions.choice: rivers ... Nile channels: the canals and branches of the Nile
decisions.reason: The first word is "rivers", here the canals that carried the Nile's water to the fields. The second is the plural of the Egyptian word for the Nile, its branches and channels in the delta.

decisions.choice: Matsor: a name for Egypt
decisions.reason: The word is a poetic name for Egypt, perhaps Lower Egypt, as in 37:25 and 2 Kings 19:24. It may also be heard as "siege" or "fortress".

decisions.choice: Egypt
decisions.reason: All three levels say "Egypt" for the poetic name Matsor, since the name is unfamiliar and means the same land.

decisions.choice: ye'orei matsor "エジプトのナイルの支流" (L, B), "ナイル川の流れ" (R); Matsor is "エジプト" at every level, as the English (m2).
decisions.reason: Matsor is a poetic name for Egypt; the English gives Egypt at every level and Japanese follows it.

source.text: עָר֥וֹת עַל־יְא֖וֹר עַל־פִּ֣י יְא֑וֹר וְכֹל֙ מִזְרַ֣ע יְא֔וֹר יִיבַ֥שׁ נִדַּ֖ף וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Bare places by the Nile, by [the] mouth of [the] Nile, and every sown field of [the] Nile will dry up, be driven away, and it will not be.

en.L: The bare places by the Nile, by the mouth of the Nile, \q and every sown field of the Nile will dry up; it will be blown away and be no more.
en.B: The bare banks beside the Nile, at the mouth of the Nile, \q and every field sown along the Nile will dry out, blow away, and be gone.
en.R: The open land along the Nile and where the Nile flows into the sea will dry up. \q Every field planted beside the river will blow away and be gone.

es.L: Los prados junto al Nilo, junto a la desembocadura del Nilo, \q y todo sembrado del Nilo se secará; será arrastrado y no existirá más.
es.B: Las riberas peladas junto al Nilo, en la desembocadura del Nilo, \q y todos los campos sembrados a lo largo del Nilo se secarán, volarán con el viento y desaparecerán.
es.R: La tierra abierta a lo largo del Nilo y donde el Nilo desemboca en el mar se secará. \q Todos los campos sembrados junto al río se los llevará el viento y desaparecerán.

fr.L: Les prés au bord du Nil, à l’embouchure du Nil, \q et tout champ ensemencé du Nil se dessécheront ; il sera emporté et ne sera plus.
fr.B: Les rives dénudées le long du Nil, à l’embouchure du Nil, \q et tous les champs semés au bord du Nil se dessécheront, s’envoleront et disparaîtront.
fr.R: Les terres le long du Nil et là où le Nil se jette dans la mer se dessécheront. \q Tous les champs plantés au bord du fleuve s’envoleront et disparaîtront.

sw.L: Maeneo matupu kando ya Naili, kwenye mlango wa Naili, \q na kila shamba lililopandwa kando ya Naili litakauka; litapeperushwa na kutokuwepo tena.
sw.B: Kingo tupu kando ya mto Naili, kwenye mlango wa Naili, \q na kila shamba lililopandwa kando ya Naili litakauka, litapeperushwa na kutoweka.
sw.R: Ardhi iliyo wazi kando ya mto Naili na mahali Naili unapoingia baharini itakauka. \q Kila shamba lililopandwa kando ya mto litapeperushwa na kutoweka.

vi.L: Những bãi trống dọc sông Nin, nơi cửa sông Nin, \q và mọi ruộng gieo bên sông Nin sẽ khô héo; sẽ bị thổi bay và không còn nữa.
vi.B: Những bãi đất trống bên sông Nin, nơi cửa sông Nin, \q và mọi cánh đồng gieo trồng dọc sông Nin sẽ khô cằn, bị gió cuốn đi, và mất hẳn.
vi.R: Đất trống dọc sông Nin và nơi sông Nin đổ ra biển sẽ khô cạn. \q Mọi cánh đồng trồng trọt bên sông sẽ bị gió thổi bay và không còn gì.

ko.L: 나일 강 가의 맨땅과 나일 강 어귀와 \q 나일 강 가에 씨 뿌린 모든 밭이 말라, 날려 가서 없어질 것이다.
ko.B: 나일 강가의 빈 들과 나일 강 어귀, \q 나일 강을 따라 씨 뿌린 모든 밭이 말라서 바람에 날려 사라질 것이다.
ko.R: 나일 강가의 들판과 나일 강이 바다로 흘러드는 곳이 말라 버릴 것이다. \q 강가에 씨를 뿌린 밭들이 모두 바람에 날려 없어질 것이다.

pt.L: As margens nuas junto ao Nilo, junto à foz do Nilo, \q e todo campo semeado do Nilo secará; será levado [pelo vento] e não existirá mais.
pt.B: As margens descobertas ao lado do Nilo, na foz do Nilo, \q e todo campo semeado junto ao Nilo vão secar, voar com o vento e desaparecer.
pt.R: As terras abertas ao longo do Nilo e onde o Nilo deságua no mar vão secar. \q Todos os campos plantados à beira do rio vão ser levados pelo vento e desaparecer.

am.L: በወንዙ አጠገብ፣ በወንዙ አፍ ያሉ ባዶ ስፍራዎች፣ \q በወንዙም ዳር የተዘራ እርሻ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፤ ተበትኖም ይጠፋል።
am.B: በዓባይ አጠገብ፣ በዓባይ አፍ ያሉት ባዶ ዳርቻዎች፣ \q በዓባይ ዳር የተዘራ እርሻ ሁሉ ይደርቃል፤ በነፋስ ተወስዶም ይጠፋል።
am.R: በዓባይ ወንዝ ዳር ያለው ገላጣ ምድርና ወንዙ ወደ ባሕር በሚገባበት ያለው ምድር ይደርቃል። \q በወንዙ ዳር የተዘራ እርሻ ሁሉ በነፋስ ተወስዶ ይጠፋል።

hi.L: नील के किनारे के, नील के मुहाने के खुले स्थान, \q और नील के किनारे का हर बोया हुआ खेत सूख जाएगा; वह उड़ जाएगा और न रहेगा।
hi.B: नील के पास के नंगे तट, नील के मुहाने पर, \q और नील के किनारे बोया गया हर खेत सूख जाएगा, उड़ जाएगा और मिट जाएगा।
hi.R: नील के किनारे की खुली भूमि और जहाँ नील समुद्र में मिलती है, वह भूमि सूख जाएगी। \q नदी के किनारे लगाया गया हर खेत उड़ जाएगा और मिट जाएगा।

ru.L: Голые места у Нила, у устья Нила, \q и всякое засеянное поле Нила высохнет, развеется, и не будет его.
ru.B: Голые берега вдоль Нила, у самого его устья, \q и каждое поле, засеянное у Нила, высохнет, развеется ветром и исчезнет.
ru.R: Открытая земля вдоль Нила и там, где Нил впадает в море, высохнет. \q Каждое поле, засеянное у реки, развеет ветер, и его не станет.

ja.L: ナイルのほとり、ナイルの河口の裸の土地も、 \q ナイルの種をまいた畑もすべて干上がり、吹き飛ばされ、なくなる。
ja.B: ナイルのほとり、ナイルの河口の何もない土手も、 \q ナイル沿いの種をまいた畑もすべて干からび、吹き飛ばされて消える。
ja.R: ナイル川沿いの開けた土地も、ナイル川が海に流れ込む所も、干上がる。 \q 川のそばで種をまいた畑は、みな吹き飛ばされてなくなる。

decisions.choice: bare places: open ground along the river
decisions.reason: The word is from a root meaning "bare" or "exposed" and is found only here. It may mean open ground or meadows along the bank, or the reeds that grow there.

decisions.choice: the mouth of the Nile: the delta, where it meets the sea
decisions.reason: The "mouth" may be where the Nile flows into the sea, or simply its edge or bank.

decisions.choice: every sown field: the crops that depend on the river
decisions.reason: Egypt's farms were watered by the Nile's yearly flood. When the river fails, the fields dry to dust and the wind carries them away.

decisions.choice: ye'or "ナイル" (L, B), "ナイル川" (R), as the English names it at every level; 'arot "裸の土地" (L), "何もない土手" (B), "開けた土地" (R).
decisions.reason: 'arot is uncertain (m1, footnoted); Japanese keeps the English reading of open ground by the river.

source.text: וְאָנוּ֙ הַדַּיָּגִ֔ים וְאָ֣בְל֔וּ כָּל־מַשְׁלִיכֵ֥י בַיְא֖וֹר חַכָּ֑ה וּפֹרְשֵׂ֥י מִכְמֹ֛רֶת עַל־פְּנֵי־מַ֖יִם אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will lament the fishermen, and will mourn all [those who] cast in [the] Nile a hook, and [those who] spread out a net on [the] surface of [the] waters will languish.

en.L: And the fishermen will lament, \q and all who cast a hook in the Nile will mourn, \q and those who spread out a net on the surface of the waters will languish.
en.B: The fishermen will moan and grieve, \q all who drop a hook into the Nile, \q and those who spread their nets over the water will lose heart.
en.R: Those who fish will cry and be sad. \q Those who fish with hooks in the Nile or throw nets on the water will lose hope.

es.L: Y los pescadores se lamentarán, \q y harán duelo todos los que echan anzuelo en el Nilo, \q y los que extienden la red sobre la superficie de las aguas languidecerán.
es.B: Los pescadores gemirán y se lamentarán, \q todos los que echan el anzuelo en el Nilo, \q y los que tienden sus redes sobre el agua se desanimarán.
es.R: Los que pescan llorarán y estarán tristes. \q Los que pescan con anzuelo en el Nilo o echan redes en el agua perderán la esperanza.

fr.L: Et les pêcheurs se lamenteront, \q et tous ceux qui jettent l’hameçon dans le Nil seront en deuil, \q et ceux qui étendent le filet sur la surface des eaux languiront.
fr.B: Les pêcheurs gémiront et pleureront, \q tous ceux qui lancent l’hameçon dans le Nil, \q et ceux qui déploient leurs filets sur l’eau perdront courage.
fr.R: Les pêcheurs pleureront et seront tristes. \q Ceux qui pêchent à l’hameçon dans le Nil ou qui jettent leurs filets sur l’eau perdront espoir.

sw.L: Na wavuvi wataomboleza, \q na wote wanaotupa ndoano katika Naili watalia, \q na wale wanaotandaza wavu juu ya uso wa maji watadhoofika.
sw.B: Wavuvi watalalamika na kuomboleza, \q wote wanaotupa ndoano katika mto Naili, \q na wanaotandaza nyavu zao juu ya maji watakata tamaa.
sw.R: Wavuvi watalia na kuhuzunika. \q Wale wanaovua kwa ndoano katika mto Naili au kutupa nyavu majini watakata tamaa.

vi.L: Những người đánh cá sẽ than vãn, \q mọi người thả lưỡi câu trên sông Nin sẽ khóc than, \q và những người giăng lưới trên mặt nước sẽ mòn mỏi.
vi.B: Những người đánh cá sẽ rên rỉ và than khóc, \q tất cả những ai thả câu trên sông Nin, \q và những người giăng lưới trên mặt nước sẽ chán nản.
vi.R: Những người đánh cá sẽ khóc lóc và buồn bã. \q Những ai câu cá trên sông Nin hay quăng lưới trên mặt nước sẽ mất hết hy vọng.

ko.L: 그리고 어부들이 탄식하고, \q 나일 강에 낚시를 던지는 모든 자가 슬퍼하며, \q 물 위에 그물을 펴는 자들이 기운을 잃을 것이다.
ko.B: 어부들이 신음하며 슬퍼하고, \q 나일 강에 낚시를 드리우는 사람들도 모두 슬퍼하며, \q 물 위에 그물을 치는 사람들도 맥이 빠질 것이다.
ko.R: 고기를 잡는 사람들이 울며 슬퍼할 것이다. \q 나일 강에서 낚시하는 사람들과 물에 그물을 던지는 사람들이 모두 희망을 잃을 것이다.

pt.L: E os pescadores se lamentarão, \q e todos os que lançam anzol no Nilo prantearão, \q e os que estendem rede sobre a superfície das águas desfalecerão.
pt.B: Os pescadores vão gemer e chorar, \q todos os que jogam o anzol no Nilo, \q e os que estendem as suas redes sobre as águas vão perder o ânimo.
pt.R: Os pescadores vão chorar e ficar tristes. \q Os que pescam com anzol no Nilo ou jogam redes na água vão perder a esperança.

am.L: ዓሣ አጥማጆችም ያለቅሳሉ፤ \q በወንዙም መንጠቆ የሚጥሉ ሁሉ ያዝናሉ፤ \q በውኆችም ላይ መረብ የሚዘረጉ ይዝላሉ።
am.B: ዓሣ አጥማጆች ያቃስታሉ፤ ያዝናሉም፤ \q በዓባይ መንጠቆ የሚጥሉ ሁሉ፤ \q በውኃ ላይ መረባቸውን የሚዘረጉም ተስፋ ይቆርጣሉ።
am.R: ዓሣ የሚያጠምዱ ሰዎች ያለቅሳሉ፤ ያዝናሉም። \q በዓባይ ወንዝ በመንጠቆ የሚያጠምዱና በውኃ ላይ መረብ የሚጥሉ ተስፋ ይቆርጣሉ።

hi.L: और मछुए विलाप करेंगे, \q और नील में बंसी डालनेवाले सब शोक करेंगे, \q और जल के ऊपर जाल फैलानेवाले निर्बल हो जाएँगे।
hi.B: मछुए कराहेंगे और शोक करेंगे, \q वे सब जो नील में बंसी डालते हैं, \q और जो जल पर अपने जाल फैलाते हैं, उनका मन टूट जाएगा।
hi.R: मछली पकड़नेवाले रोएँगे और दुखी होंगे। \q जो नील में काँटे से मछली पकड़ते हैं या पानी पर जाल डालते हैं, वे आशा खो देंगे।

ru.L: И восплачут рыбаки, \q и будут скорбеть все, бросающие в Нил крючок, \q и раскидывающие сеть по поверхности вод изнемогут.
ru.B: Рыбаки будут стонать и горевать, \q все, кто забрасывает в Нил крючок, \q и те, кто раскидывает сети по воде, падут духом.
ru.R: Рыбаки будут плакать и печалиться. \q Те, кто ловит рыбу в Ниле крючком или забрасывает сети в воду, потеряют надежду.

ja.L: そして、漁師たちは嘆き、 \q ナイルに釣り針を投げる者たちはみな悲しみ、 \q 水の面に網を広げる者たちはしおれる。
ja.B: 漁師たちはうめき悲しみ、 \q ナイルに釣り針を垂らす者はみな嘆き、 \q 水の上に網を打つ者たちは気力を失う。
ja.R: 魚をとる人たちは、泣き悲しむ。 \q ナイル川で釣りをする人も、水に網を打つ人も、希望をなくす。

decisions.choice: fishermen, hook and net: Egypt's fishing trade
decisions.reason: Fish from the Nile were a main food in Egypt (Numbers 11:5). Both hook-fishing and net-fishing will fail.

decisions.choice: languish: grow weak, waste away
decisions.reason: The verb is used of plants wilting and of people losing strength through grief (16:8; 24:4, 7).

source.text: וּבֹ֛שׁוּ עֹבְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׂרִיק֑וֹת וְאֹרְגִ֖ים חוֹרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be ashamed [those who] work flax combed, and [those who] weave white cloth.

en.L: And those who work combed flax will be ashamed, \q and those who weave white cloth.
en.B: The workers who comb flax will be put to shame, \q along with the weavers of white linen.
en.R: People who make linen from flax will be ashamed and confused, \q and so will those who weave white cloth.

es.L: Y se avergonzarán los que trabajan el lino peinado, \q y los que tejen tela blanca.
es.B: Los que peinan el lino quedarán avergonzados, \q junto con los tejedores de lino blanco.
es.R: La gente que hace telas de lino quedará avergonzada y confundida, \q y también los que tejen tela blanca.

fr.L: Et ceux qui travaillent le lin peigné seront confus, \q et ceux qui tissent le coton blanc.
fr.B: Les ouvriers qui peignent le lin seront couverts de honte, \q ainsi que les tisserands de toile blanche.
fr.R: Les gens qui fabriquent le lin seront honteux et désemparés, \q et ceux qui tissent la toile blanche aussi.

sw.L: Na wanaofanya kazi ya kitani kilichochanwa wataaibika, \q na wale wanaofuma nguo nyeupe.
sw.B: Wafanyakazi wanaochana kitani wataaibishwa, \q pamoja na wafumaji wa kitani nyeupe.
sw.R: Watu wanaotengeneza nguo za kitani wataona aibu na kuchanganyikiwa, \q nao wanaofuma nguo nyeupe vivyo hivyo.

vi.L: Những người làm sợi gai chải sẽ hổ thẹn, \q và những người dệt vải trắng [cũng vậy].
vi.B: Những thợ chải sợi gai sẽ bị hổ thẹn, \q cùng với những thợ dệt vải gai trắng.
vi.R: Những người làm vải từ sợi gai sẽ xấu hổ và bối rối, \q và những người dệt vải trắng cũng vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 빗질한 삼으로 일하는 자들이 부끄러워하고, \q 흰 천을 짜는 자들도 [그러할 것이다].
ko.B: 삼을 빗어 실을 뽑는 일꾼들이 부끄러움을 당하고, \q 흰 모시를 짜는 사람들도 그러할 것이다.
ko.R: 삼으로 모시를 만드는 사람들이 부끄러워하고 어쩔 줄 몰라 할 것이다. \q 흰 천을 짜는 사람들도 그러할 것이다.

pt.L: E serão envergonhados os que trabalham o linho penteado, \q e os que tecem pano branco.
pt.B: Os que penteiam o linho ficarão envergonhados, \q junto com os tecelões de linho branco.
pt.R: As pessoas que fazem tecido de linho vão ficar envergonhadas e confusas, \q e também as que tecem pano branco.

am.L: የተበጠረውን ተልባ የሚሠሩ ያፍራሉ፤ \q ነጭ ልብስም የሚሸምኑ።
am.B: ተልባ የሚበጥሩ ሠራተኞች ያፍራሉ፤ \q ነጭ በፍታ የሚሸምኑም ከእነርሱ ጋር።
am.R: ከተልባ በፍታ የሚሠሩ ሰዎች ያፍራሉ፤ ግራም ይጋባሉ። \q ነጭ ልብስ የሚሸምኑም እንዲሁ።

hi.L: और कंघी किए हुए सन का काम करनेवाले लज्जित होंगे, \q और सफ़ेद कपड़ा बुननेवाले भी।
hi.B: सन को कंघी करनेवाले कारीगर लज्जित होंगे, \q और उनके साथ सफ़ेद मलमल बुननेवाले भी।
hi.R: जो लोग सन से मलमल बनाते हैं, वे लज्जित और उलझन में होंगे, \q और सफ़ेद कपड़ा बुननेवाले भी।

ru.L: И постыдятся обрабатывающие чёсаный лён \q и ткущие белое полотно.
ru.B: Посрамлены будут работники, что чешут лён, \q и ткачи белого полотна.
ru.R: Люди, которые делают полотно из льна, будут посрамлены и растеряны, \q и те, кто ткёт белую ткань, тоже.

ja.L: そして、すいた亜麻を扱う者たちは恥を見る。 \q 白い布を織る者たちも。
ja.B: 亜麻をすく職人たちは恥を見る。 \q 白い亜麻布を織る者たちも同じだ。
ja.R: 亜麻から麻布を作る人たちは、恥をかいて途方に暮れる。 \q 白い布を織る人たちも同じだ。

decisions.choice: combed flax: flax prepared for spinning into linen
decisions.reason: Egypt was known for its fine linen (Genesis 41:42; Proverbs 7:16; Ezekiel 27:7). Flax needs water to grow, so when the Nile fails, the linen trade fails too.

decisions.choice: be ashamed: be dismayed, disappointed
decisions.reason: The verb means to be put to shame, especially when what one relied on fails (1:29; 20:5).

source.text: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁתֹתֶ֖יהָ מְדֻכָּאִ֑ים כָּל־עֹ֥שֵׂי שֶׂ֖כֶר אַגְמֵי־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be, its foundations, crushed; all [those who] work for wages [will be] grieved of soul.

en.L: And its foundations will be crushed; \q all who work for wages will be grieved of soul.
en.B: Its pillars will be broken, \q and all who work for hire will be sick at heart.
en.R: The people Egypt depends on will be crushed, \q and all the hired workers will be very sad.

es.L: Y sus cimientos serán aplastados; \q todos los que trabajan a jornal [estarán] afligidos de alma.
es.B: Sus pilares quedarán destrozados, \q y todos los que trabajan a sueldo tendrán el corazón angustiado.
es.R: Las personas de las que Egipto depende quedarán destrozadas, \q y todos los trabajadores a sueldo estarán muy tristes.

fr.L: Et ses fondements seront écrasés ; \q tous ceux qui travaillent pour un salaire [seront] affligés dans leur âme.
fr.B: Ses piliers seront brisés, \q et tous ceux qui travaillent à gages auront le cœur malade.
fr.R: Les gens sur qui l’Égypte compte seront écrasés, \q et tous les ouvriers payés à la journée seront très tristes.

sw.L: Na nguzo zake zitapondwa; \q wote wanaofanya kazi kwa ujira [watakuwa] na huzuni ya nafsi.
sw.B: Nguzo zake zitavunjwa, \q na wote wanaofanya kazi ya kuajiriwa watahuzunika moyoni.
sw.R: Watu ambao Misri inawategemea watapondwa, \q na wafanyakazi wote wa kuajiriwa watahuzunika sana.

vi.L: Các nền tảng của nó sẽ bị nghiền nát; \q mọi kẻ làm thuê sẽ buồn rầu trong lòng.
vi.B: Các trụ cột của xứ sẽ bị đập tan, \q và mọi người làm thuê đều đau lòng.
vi.R: Những người mà Ai Cập nương cậy sẽ bị nghiền nát, \q và mọi người làm thuê sẽ rất buồn bã.

ko.L: 그리고 그 기둥들이 부서지고, \q 품삯을 받고 일하는 모든 자가 마음에 슬픔을 [품을 것이다].
ko.B: 나라의 기둥들이 꺾이고, \q 품을 파는 사람들은 모두 마음이 아플 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트가 의지하던 사람들이 무너질 것이다. \q 품을 파는 일꾼들도 모두 몹시 슬퍼할 것이다.

pt.L: E os seus fundamentos serão esmagados; \q todos os que trabalham por salário [ficarão] aflitos de alma.
pt.B: As suas colunas serão quebradas, \q e todos os que trabalham por salário ficarão com o coração doente.
pt.R: As pessoas de quem o Egito depende serão esmagadas, \q e todos os trabalhadores contratados vão ficar muito tristes.

am.L: መሠረቶቿም ይደቅቃሉ፤ \q በደመወዝ የሚሠሩም ሁሉ በነፍሳቸው ያዝናሉ።
am.B: ምሰሶዎቿ ይሰበራሉ፤ \q ተቀጥረው የሚሠሩም ሁሉ ልባቸው ይታመማል።
am.R: ግብፅ የምትመካባቸው ሰዎች ይደቅቃሉ፤ \q ቅጥር ሠራተኞችም ሁሉ እጅግ ያዝናሉ።

hi.L: और उसकी नींव कुचल दी जाएगी; \q सब मज़दूरी करनेवाले मन में दुखी होंगे।
hi.B: उसके खंभे तोड़ दिए जाएँगे, \q और मज़दूरी पर काम करनेवाले सब के मन दुखी होंगे।
hi.R: जिन लोगों पर मिस्र निर्भर है, वे कुचल दिए जाएँगे, \q और सब मज़दूर बहुत दुखी होंगे।

ru.L: И будут основания его сокрушены; \q все работающие за плату — скорбны душой.
ru.B: Его опоры будут разбиты, \q и все, кто трудится за плату, падут духом.
ru.R: Люди, на которых держится Египет, будут сломлены, \q и все наёмные работники будут очень печальны.

ja.L: そして、その土台は砕かれ、 \q 賃金のために働く者たちはみな心を痛める。
ja.B: その柱となる者たちは打ち砕かれ、 \q 雇われて働く者はみな心を病む。
ja.R: エジプトが頼りにしている人たちは、打ち砕かれる。 \q 雇われて働く人たちは、みなひどく悲しむ。

decisions.choice: its foundations: the pillars of the land, its leading people
decisions.reason: The word means foundations in Psalm 11:3, and here may picture the people who hold up the nation's life. A related word means the warp threads of a loom, so it may mean "its weavers", continuing verse 9. The Septuagint takes it as "those who work them".

decisions.choice: wages: those who work for hire
decisions.reason: The word means hire or wages (Proverbs 11:18). Some have read it as "dams" for fish ponds, but "wages" is the word's usual sense.

decisions.choice: The people Egypt depends on
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of foundations as the people a country depends on.

decisions.choice: shatotheha "その土台" (L), "その柱となる者たち" (B), "エジプトが頼りにしている人たち" (R), the land's leading people (m1).
decisions.reason: The word is uncertain (m1, footnoted); Japanese follows the English reading at each level.

source.text: אַךְ־אֱוִלִים֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן חַכְמֵי֙ יֹעֲצֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה עֵצָ֖ה נִבְעָרָ֑ה אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֔ה בֶּן־חֲכָמִ֥ים אֲנִ֖י בֶּן־מַלְכֵי־קֶֽדֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only fools [are the] officials of Zoan; [the] wise of [the] counselors of Pharaoh [give] counsel stupid. How will you say to Pharaoh, a son of wise [men am] I, a son of kings of old?

en.L: Surely the officials of Zoan are fools; \q the wise counselors of Pharaoh give stupid counsel. \q How can you say to Pharaoh, "I am a son of the wise, a son of ancient kings"?
en.B: Zoan's officials are complete fools; \q the wisest men who advise Pharaoh offer witless counsel. \q How can you tell Pharaoh, "I come from a line of wise men, from kings of long ago"?
en.R: The leaders in the city of Zoan are very foolish. \q Pharaoh's wisest advisers give him stupid advice. \q How can you advisers say to Pharaoh, "I come from a family of wise men. My ancestors were ancient kings"?

es.L: Ciertamente son necios los príncipes de Zoán; \q los sabios consejeros del faraón dan consejo insensato. \q ¿Cómo {{plural_you:pueden decir|podéis decir}} al faraón: «Yo soy hijo de sabios, hijo de reyes antiguos»?
es.B: Los príncipes de Zoán son completamente necios; \q los más sabios entre los que aconsejan al faraón dan consejos sin sentido. \q ¿Cómo {{plural_you:pueden decirle|podéis decirle}} al faraón: «Vengo de un linaje de sabios, de reyes de tiempos antiguos»?
es.R: Los líderes de la ciudad de Zoán son muy necios. \q Los consejeros más sabios del faraón le dan consejos tontos. \q ¿Cómo pueden {{plural_you:ustedes, consejeros, decirle|vosotros, consejeros, decirle}} al faraón: «Vengo de una familia de sabios. Mis antepasados fueron reyes antiguos»?

fr.L: Certes, les princes de Tsoan sont des insensés ; \q les sages conseillers du pharaon donnent un conseil stupide. \q Comment pouvez-vous dire au pharaon : « Je suis fils de sages, fils de rois d’autrefois » ?
fr.B: Les princes de Tsoan ne sont que des insensés ; \q les plus sages conseillers du pharaon donnent des avis absurdes. \q Comment pouvez-vous dire au pharaon : « Je descends d’une lignée de sages, de rois des temps anciens » ?
fr.R: Les chefs de la ville de Tsoan sont très bêtes. \q Les conseillers les plus sages du pharaon lui donnent des conseils stupides. \q Vous, les conseillers, comment pouvez-vous dire au pharaon : « Je viens d’une famille de sages. Mes ancêtres étaient des rois d’autrefois » ?

sw.L: Hakika wakuu wa Soani ni wapumbavu; \q washauri wenye hekima wa Farao wanatoa shauri la kijinga. \q Mnawezaje kumwambia Farao, "Mimi ni mwana wa wenye hekima, mwana wa wafalme wa kale"?
sw.B: Maafisa wa Soani ni wapumbavu kabisa; \q wenye hekima kuliko wote wanaomshauri Farao wanatoa ushauri usio na akili. \q Mnawezaje kumwambia Farao, "Mimi natoka katika ukoo wa wenye hekima, wa wafalme wa zamani"?
sw.R: Viongozi wa mji wa Soani ni wapumbavu sana. \q Washauri wa Farao walio na hekima kuliko wote wanampa ushauri wa kijinga. \q Enyi washauri, mnawezaje kumwambia Farao, "Ninatoka katika jamaa ya watu wenye hekima. Babu zangu walikuwa wafalme wa kale"?

vi.L: Thật, các quan trưởng Xô-an đều là kẻ ngu dại; \q các mưu sĩ khôn ngoan của Pha-ra-ôn đưa ra mưu kế ngu xuẩn. \q Sao các ngươi có thể nói với Pha-ra-ôn: "Tôi là con của người khôn ngoan, con của các vua thời xưa"?
vi.B: Các quan chức Xô-an thật là ngu dại; \q những mưu sĩ khôn ngoan nhất của Pha-ra-ôn lại bày mưu kế dại dột. \q Sao các ngươi dám nói với Pha-ra-ôn: "Tôi thuộc dòng dõi các nhà thông thái, dòng dõi các vua thời xa xưa"?
vi.R: Các lãnh đạo ở thành Xô-an thật là ngu dại. \q Những cố vấn khôn ngoan nhất của Pha-ra-ôn lại cho vua những lời khuyên ngu xuẩn. \q Hỡi các cố vấn, sao các ngươi có thể nói với Pha-ra-ôn: "Tôi xuất thân từ một gia đình người khôn ngoan. Tổ tiên tôi là các vua thời xưa"?

ko.L: 소안의 고관들은 참으로 어리석고, \q 바로의 지혜로운 조언자들은 어리석은 계략을 [낸다]. \q 너희가 어떻게 바로에게 "나는 지혜로운 자들의 아들이요, 옛 왕들의 아들입니다" 하고 말하겠느냐?
ko.B: 소안의 관리들은 그야말로 어리석은 자들이다. \q 바로에게 조언하는 가장 지혜로운 자들도 엉터리 조언을 할 뿐이다. \q 너희가 어떻게 바로에게 "저는 지혜로운 사람들의 후손이요, 옛 왕들의 자손입니다" 하고 말할 수 있겠느냐?
ko.R: 소안 성의 지도자들은 아주 어리석다. \q 바로의 가장 지혜로운 조언자들도 바보 같은 조언을 한다. \q 조언자들아, 너희가 어떻게 바로에게 "저는 지혜로운 사람들의 집안에서 났습니다. 제 조상들은 옛날의 왕들이었습니다" 하고 말할 수 있겠느냐?

pt.L: Certamente os oficiais de Zoã são tolos; \q os sábios conselheiros de Faraó dão conselho insensato. \q Como podem dizer a Faraó: "Sou filho de sábios, filho de reis antigos"?
pt.B: Os oficiais de Zoã são completos tolos; \q os mais sábios conselheiros de Faraó dão conselhos sem juízo. \q Como vocês podem dizer a Faraó: "Venho de uma linhagem de sábios, de reis de muito tempo atrás"?
pt.R: Os líderes da cidade de Zoã são muito tolos. \q Os conselheiros mais sábios de Faraó lhe dão conselhos tolos. \q Como vocês, conselheiros, podem dizer a Faraó: "Venho de uma família de sábios. Os meus antepassados eram reis antigos"?

am.L: የጾዓን ሹማምንት በእርግጥ ሰነፎች ናቸው፤ \q የፈርዖን ጥበበኞች አማካሪዎች የደንቆሮ ምክር ይመክራሉ። \q ፈርዖንን፦ «እኔ የጥበበኞች ልጅ፣ የጥንት ነገሥታት ልጅ ነኝ» እንዴት ትሉታላችሁ?
am.B: የጾዓን ሹማምንት ፈጽመው ሰነፎች ናቸው፤ \q ፈርዖንን የሚመክሩት ጥበበኞች እንኳ የማይረባ ምክር ይሰጣሉ። \q ፈርዖንን፦ «እኔ ከጥበበኞች ዘር፣ ከጥንት ነገሥታት የተወለድኩ ነኝ» እንዴት ትሉታላችሁ?
am.R: በጾዓን ከተማ ያሉት መሪዎች እጅግ ሰነፎች ናቸው። \q የፈርዖን ጥበበኛ አማካሪዎች የሞኝነት ምክር ይሰጡታል። \q እናንተ አማካሪዎች ፈርዖንን፦ «እኔ የጥበበኞች ቤተሰብ ነኝ። አባቶቼ የጥንት ነገሥታት ነበሩ» እንዴት ልትሉት ትችላላችሁ?

hi.L: निश्चय सोअन के हाकिम मूर्ख हैं; \q फ़िरौन के बुद्धिमान मंत्री मूर्खता की सम्मति देते हैं। \q तुम फ़िरौन से कैसे कह सकते हो, "मैं बुद्धिमानों का पुत्र हूँ, प्राचीन राजाओं का पुत्र"?
hi.B: सोअन के हाकिम निरे मूर्ख हैं; \q फ़िरौन को सलाह देनेवाले सबसे बुद्धिमान लोग बेतुकी सलाह देते हैं। \q तुम फ़िरौन से कैसे कह सकते हो, "मैं बुद्धिमानों के वंश का हूँ, प्राचीन काल के राजाओं के वंश का"?
hi.R: सोअन नगर के अगुवे बहुत मूर्ख हैं। \q फ़िरौन के सबसे बुद्धिमान सलाहकार उसे मूर्खता भरी सलाह देते हैं। \q हे सलाहकारो, तुम फ़िरौन से कैसे कह सकते हो, "मैं बुद्धिमानों के परिवार से हूँ। मेरे पूर्वज प्राचीन राजा थे"?

ru.L: Истинно, глупцы — князья Цоана; \q мудрые советники фараона дают глупый совет. \q Как вы скажете фараону: «Я — сын мудрецов, сын древних царей»?
ru.B: Князья Цоана — совершенные глупцы; \q мудрейшие из тех, кто советует фараону, дают бестолковые советы. \q Как вы можете говорить фараону: «Я из рода мудрецов, из рода царей древности»?
ru.R: Вожди в городе Цоан очень глупы. \q Самые мудрые советники фараона дают ему глупые советы. \q Как вы, советники, можете говорить фараону: «Я из семьи мудрецов. Мои предки были древними царями»?

ja.L: まことに、ツォアンの長たちは愚か者だ。 \q ファラオの知恵ある助言者たちは、愚かなはかりごとを授ける。 \q どうしてあなたがたはファラオに、「わたしは知恵ある者たちの子、いにしえの王たちの子だ」と言えるのか？
ja.B: ツォアンの高官たちは、まったくの愚か者だ。 \q ファラオに助言する最も賢い者たちも、愚かなはかりごとしか出さない。 \q どうしてあなたがたはファラオに、「わたしは賢者の家系の者、いにしえの王たちの子孫だ」と言えるのか？
ja.R: ツォアンの町の指導者たちは、とても愚かだ。 \q ファラオのいちばん賢い相談役たちも、ばかげた助言をする。 \q 相談役たちよ、どうしてファラオに、「わたしは知恵のある家系の者だ。わたしの先祖は昔の王たちだ」と言えるのか？

decisions.choice: Zoan: a royal city in the Nile delta
decisions.reason: Zoan (Tanis) was an ancient city in the north-east of the delta (Numbers 13:22; Psalm 78:12) and a seat of Egypt's rulers in Isaiah's time.

decisions.choice: a son of the wise ... a son of kings: one who belongs to a line of sages and kings
decisions.reason: "Son of" can mean a member of a group or a descendant. The counselors boast of their heritage of wisdom and of royal descent.

decisions.choice: you advisers
decisions.reason: Readable names whom "you" addresses: the counselors who claim to be wise.

decisions.choice: "Tsoan ... le pharaon"
decisions.reason: The town keeps its Hebrew name in the published French spelling pattern ("ts", as Tsoar); "the pharaoh" is a title, lowercase with the article, as "le pharaon Néko" in Kings.

decisions.choice: "바로" for Pharaoh
decisions.reason: The Kings note's form (바로 느고). The counselors speak to the king in the formal style (합쇼체).

decisions.choice: Zoã; Faraó; vocês
decisions.reason: The city takes its Portuguese form "Zoã", as in Numbers 13:22 and Psalm 78:12. "Faraó" without the article, as the English says "Pharaoh", is a title used as a name (terms doc). The question is put to the counselors in the plural, so "vocês".

decisions.choice: Zoan "ጾዓን" (as Numbers 13:22); fool (ʾewil) "ሰነፍ"; officials (sarim) "ሹማምንት"
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form on main, and the fool word follows the Nehemiah-Proverbs list.

decisions.choice: सोअन; फ़िरौन
decisions.reason: Zoan keeps the form of Numbers 13:22 and Pharaoh the form of the Pentateuch note. The prophet addresses the counselors, who take तुम.

decisions.choice: Zoan "ツォアン" (Numbers 13:22); Pharaoh "ファラオ" (Exodus, ACTS 7); sarim "長たち" (L), "高官たち" (B), "指導者たち" (R) and yo'ets "助言者" (L, B), "相談役" (R), as the Isaiah key words; the advisers' claim is quoted in the plain style, as all speech inside an oracle.
alternatives: "わたしは知恵ある者の子です" (polite to the king)
decisions.reason: Isaiah conventions: no です・ます inside an oracle, whoever speaks; the quotation mark is kept as the English has it.

source.text: אַיָּם֙ אֵפ֣וֹא חֲכָמֶ֔יךָ וְיַגִּ֥ידוּ נָ֖א לָ֑ךְ וְיֵ֣דְע֔וּ מַה־יָּעַ֛ץ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Where [are] they then, your wise [men]? And let them tell, please, to you, and let them know what has planned Yahweh of hosts against Egypt.

en.L: Where are they, then, your wise men? \q Let them tell you, please, \q and let them know what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has planned against Egypt.
en.B: So where are your wise men? \q Let them explain to you, \q if they know, what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies intends for Egypt.
en.R: Pharaoh, where are your wise men? \q Let them tell you what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has planned to do to Egypt, if they really know.

es.L: ¿Dónde están, pues, tus sabios? \q Que te lo digan, por favor, \q y que sepan lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha planeado contra Egipto.
es.B: ¿Dónde están, pues, tus sabios? \q Que te expliquen, \q si es que lo saben, lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos se propone hacer con Egipto.
es.R: Faraón, ¿dónde están tus sabios? \q Que te digan lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha planeado hacerle a Egipto, si de verdad lo saben.

fr.L: Où sont-ils donc, tes sages ? \q Qu’ils te le disent, je te prie, \q et qu’ils sachent ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a projeté contre l’Égypte.
fr.B: Où sont donc tes sages ? \q Qu’ils t’expliquent, \q s’ils le savent, ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a décidé contre l’Égypte.
fr.R: Pharaon, où sont tes sages ? \q Qu’ils te disent ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a prévu de faire à l’Égypte, s’ils le savent vraiment.

sw.L: Wako wapi basi, wenye hekima wako? \q Na wakuambie, tafadhali, \q na wajue {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amepanga nini juu ya Misri.
sw.B: Basi wako wapi wenye hekima wako? \q Na wakueleze, \q kama wanajua, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anakusudia nini kwa Misri.
sw.R: Ee Farao, wako wapi wenye hekima wako? \q Na wakuambie kile ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amepanga kuifanyia Misri, kama kweli wanajua.

vi.L: Vậy những người khôn ngoan của ngươi ở đâu? \q Xin để họ nói cho ngươi biết, \q và cho biết điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã định nghịch cùng Ai Cập.
vi.B: Vậy những người khôn ngoan của ngươi đâu rồi? \q Hãy để họ giải thích cho ngươi, \q nếu họ biết, điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã định cho Ai Cập.
vi.R: Hỡi Pha-ra-ôn, những người khôn ngoan của ngươi đâu? \q Hãy để họ nói cho ngươi biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã định làm gì cho Ai Cập, nếu họ thật sự biết.

ko.L: 그러면 너의 지혜로운 자들이 어디 있느냐? \q 그들이 너에게 말하게 하여라. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트를 두고 무엇을 계획하셨는지 그들이 알게 하여라.
ko.B: 그렇다면 너의 지혜로운 자들은 어디 있느냐? \q 그들이 알고 있다면, \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트를 두고 무엇을 뜻하셨는지 너에게 말해 보라고 하여라.
ko.R: 바로야, 너의 지혜로운 자들이 어디 있느냐? \q 그들이 정말 안다면, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트에 무슨 일을 하시려고 계획하셨는지 너에게 말해 보라고 하여라.

pt.L: Onde estão eles, então, os teus sábios? \q Que te digam, por favor, \q e que saibam o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos planejou contra o Egito.
pt.B: Onde estão, então, os teus sábios? \q Que eles te expliquem, \q se é que sabem, o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos tem em mente para o Egito.
pt.R: Faraó, onde estão os teus sábios? \q Que eles te digam o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos planejou fazer contra o Egito, se é que eles sabem mesmo.

am.L: ጥበበኞችህ ታዲያ የት አሉ? \q እስቲ ይንገሩህ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት በግብፅ ላይ ያቀደውንም ይወቁ።
am.B: እንግዲህ ጥበበኞችህ የት አሉ? \q ያስረዱህ፤ \q የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በግብፅ ላይ ያሰበውን የሚያውቁ ከሆነ።
am.R: ፈርዖን ሆይ፣ ጥበበኞችህ የት አሉ? \q የሚያውቁ ከሆነ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በግብፅ ላይ ሊያደርግ ያቀደውን ይንገሩህ።

hi.L: तो वे कहाँ [हैं], तुम्हारे बुद्धिमान? \q वे तुम्हें बताएँ, \q और जान लें कि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मिस्र के विरुद्ध क्या ठाना है।
hi.B: तो कहाँ हैं तुम्हारे बुद्धिमान? \q वे तुम्हें समझाएँ, \q यदि वे जानते हैं, कि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मिस्र के लिए क्या ठाना है।
hi.R: हे फ़िरौन, कहाँ हैं तुम्हारे बुद्धिमान लोग? \q यदि वे सचमुच जानते हैं, तो तुम्हें बताएँ कि सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मिस्र के साथ क्या करने की योजना बनाई है।

ru.L: Где же они, твои мудрецы? \q Пусть они скажут тебе, \q и пусть узнают, что задумал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф о Египте.
ru.B: Так где же твои мудрецы? \q Пусть они объяснят тебе, \q если знают, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф задумал о Египте.
ru.R: Фараон, где же твои мудрецы? \q Пусть они скажут тебе, что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств задумал сделать с Египтом, если они действительно знают.

ja.L: では、彼らはどこにいるのか、あなたの知者たちは？ \q どうか、彼らがあなたに告げ、 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がエジプトについて何を計られたかを知らせるように。
ja.B: では、あなたの知者たちはどこにいるのか？ \q 彼らに説き明かさせるがいい。 \q 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がエジプトに対して何を計画しておられるかを、もし知っているなら。
ja.R: ファラオよ、あなたの知恵のある者たちは、どこにいるのか？ \q もし本当に知っているなら、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}がエジプトに何をしようと計画しておられるか、彼らに言わせてみなさい。

decisions.choice: your wise men ... tell you: Pharaoh is addressed
decisions.reason: "Your" and "you" are singular. The prophet turns to Pharaoh and challenges his advisers.

decisions.choice: what the LORD of hosts has planned: God's plan, not Egypt's
decisions.reason: Egypt's counselors make plans (verse 3), but the plan that stands is God's (14:24-27; 46:10). The verb is from the same root as "counselors" and "counsel" in verse 11.

decisions.choice: Pharaoh
decisions.reason: Readable names Pharaoh as the one addressed, as the singular "your" shows.

decisions.choice: teus, te (tu)
decisions.reason: The prophet turns to Pharaoh in the singular (m1). Kings addressed in Isaiah's oracles are spoken to with "tu", the prophet's address on God's behalf, not the courtly "o senhor" of a subject to his king.

decisions.choice: Pharaoh addressed with "አንተ" ("ጥበበኞችህ")
decisions.reason: The prophet brings God's word to a king, who is addressed with "አንተ" (Joshua-Samuel and Kings terms lists). 1 Corinthians 1:20 echoes the question ("ጥበበኛው የት [አለ]?"), which the Amharic "የት አሉ?" matches.

decisions.choice: तुम (to Pharaoh)
decisions.reason: The prophet taunts Pharaoh (m1); in a taunt Hindi uses तुम, not the courtly आप that a subject says to a king.

decisions.choice: Pharaoh addressed in the singular (m1): "あなた" at every level; the scornful jussive "告げるように" (L), "説き明かさせるがいい" (B), "言わせてみなさい" (R); God's planning with the light respect form "計られた / 計画しておられる".
decisions.reason: The tone is ironic but not a taunt against a hostile king, so the Isaiah "おまえ" is not used; "〜がいい" carries the challenge, as ISA 8:9-10.

source.text: נֽוֹאֲלוּ֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן נִשְּׁא֖וּ שָׂ֣רֵי נֹ֑ף הִתְע֥וּ אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם פִּנַּ֥ת שְׁבָטֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: They have become fools, [the] officials of Zoan; they have been deceived, [the] officials of Noph; they have led astray Egypt, [the] corner of her tribes.

en.L: The officials of Zoan have become fools; \q the officials of Memphis are deceived; \q they have led Egypt astray, the cornerstone of her tribes.
en.B: Zoan's officials have played the fool, \q and those of Memphis are deluded. \q The ones who should be the cornerstone of its tribes have sent Egypt off course.
en.R: The leaders in Zoan and Memphis have become fools. \q They have been fooled themselves. The very leaders who should hold Egypt's people together have led the country the wrong way.

es.L: Los príncipes de Zoán se han vuelto necios; \q los príncipes de Menfis están engañados; \q han extraviado a Egipto, la piedra angular de sus tribus.
es.B: Los príncipes de Zoán han actuado como necios, \q y los de Menfis están engañados. \q Los que debían ser la piedra angular de sus tribus han hecho que Egipto se desvíe.
es.R: Los líderes de Zoán y de Menfis se han vuelto necios. \q Ellos mismos han sido engañados. Los mismos líderes que debían mantener unido al pueblo de Egipto han llevado al país por mal camino.

fr.L: Les princes de Tsoan sont devenus fous ; \q les princes de Memphis se sont abusés ; \q ils ont égaré l’Égypte, eux, la pierre angulaire de ses tribus.
fr.B: Les princes de Tsoan ont agi en insensés, \q et ceux de Memphis se sont trompés. \q Ceux qui devaient être la pierre angulaire de ses tribus ont fait dévier l’Égypte.
fr.R: Les chefs de Tsoan et de Memphis sont devenus fous. \q Ils se sont eux-mêmes trompés. Les chefs qui devaient unir le peuple d’Égypte ont conduit le pays dans la mauvaise direction.

sw.L: Wakuu wa Soani wamekuwa wapumbavu; \q wakuu wa Memfisi wamedanganywa; \q wameipoteza Misri, wao walio jiwe la pembeni la makabila yake.
sw.B: Maafisa wa Soani wamefanya upumbavu, \q na wale wa Memfisi wamedanganyika. \q Wale wanaopaswa kuwa jiwe la pembeni la makabila yake wameipoteza Misri njia.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Soani na Memfisi wamekuwa wapumbavu. \q Wao wenyewe wamedanganywa. Viongozi wale wale wanaopaswa kuwaunganisha watu wa Misri wameiongoza nchi njia mbaya.

vi.L: Các quan trưởng Xô-an đã trở nên ngu dại; \q các quan trưởng Mem-phít bị lừa dối; \q chúng đã làm cho Ai Cập lầm lạc, là những hòn đá góc của các chi tộc nó.
vi.B: Các quan chức Xô-an đã hóa ra ngu dại, \q các quan chức Mem-phít bị mê muội. \q Những kẻ lẽ ra phải là đá góc của các chi tộc đã dẫn Ai Cập đi lạc.
vi.R: Các lãnh đạo ở Xô-an và Mem-phít đã trở nên ngu dại. \q Chính họ cũng bị lừa gạt. Những người lẽ ra phải giữ cho dân Ai Cập đoàn kết lại dẫn đất nước đi sai đường.

ko.L: 소안의 고관들이 어리석게 되었고, \q 멤피스의 고관들이 속았다. \q 그 지파들의 모퉁잇돌인 자들이 이집트를 그릇되게 이끌었다.
ko.B: 소안의 관리들은 어리석게 굴었고, \q 멤피스의 관리들은 속아 넘어갔다. \q 지파들의 모퉁잇돌이 되어야 할 자들이 이집트를 엉뚱한 길로 이끌었다.
ko.R: 소안과 멤피스의 지도자들은 어리석게 되었다. \q 그들 자신이 속았다. 이집트 백성을 하나로 묶어야 할 바로 그 지도자들이 나라를 잘못된 길로 이끌었다.

pt.L: Tornaram-se tolos os oficiais de Zoã; \q enganados estão os oficiais de Mênfis; \q fizeram o Egito se desviar, a pedra angular das suas tribos.
pt.B: Os oficiais de Zoã perderam o juízo, \q e os de Mênfis estão iludidos. \q Os que deviam ser a pedra angular das suas tribos levaram o Egito para o caminho errado.
pt.R: Os líderes de Zoã e de Mênfis ficaram tolos. \q Eles mesmos foram enganados. Os próprios líderes que deviam manter o povo do Egito unido levaram o país pelo caminho errado.

am.L: የጾዓን ሹማምንት ሰነፎች ሆኑ፤ \q የሜምፊስ ሹማምንትም ተታለሉ፤ \q የነገዶቿ የማዕዘን ድንጋይ የሆኑት ግብፅን አሳቱ።
am.B: የጾዓን ሹማምንት ሞኝነት አደረጉ፤ \q የሜምፊስም ሹማምንት ተታለሉ። \q የነገዶቿ የማዕዘን ድንጋይ መሆን የሚገባቸው ግብፅን ከመንገድ አሳቱ።
am.R: የጾዓንና የሜምፊስ መሪዎች ሰነፎች ሆነዋል። \q እነርሱ ራሳቸው ተታልለዋል። የግብፅን ሕዝብ አንድ አድርገው መያዝ የነበረባቸው መሪዎች አገሪቱን በተሳሳተ መንገድ መርተዋል።

hi.L: सोअन के हाकिम मूर्ख बन गए हैं; \q मेम्फ़िस के हाकिम धोखा खा गए हैं; \q उसके गोत्रों के कोने के पत्थर ने मिस्र को भटका दिया है।
hi.B: सोअन के हाकिमों ने मूर्खता की है, \q और मेम्फ़िस के हाकिम भ्रम में पड़े हैं। \q जिन्हें उसके गोत्रों के कोने का पत्थर होना चाहिए था, उन्होंने मिस्र को राह से भटका दिया है।
hi.R: सोअन और मेम्फ़िस के अगुवे मूर्ख बन गए हैं। \q वे स्वयं धोखा खा गए हैं। जिन अगुवों को मिस्र के लोगों को एक साथ बाँधे रखना चाहिए था, उन्होंने ही देश को ग़लत रास्ते पर डाल दिया है।

ru.L: Обезумели князья Цоана, \q обмануты князья Мемфиса; \q ввели Египет в заблуждение краеугольные камни его племён.
ru.B: Князья Цоана поступили как глупцы, \q князья Мемфиса обмануты. \q Те, кто должен быть краеугольным камнем его племён, сбили Египет с пути.
ru.R: Вожди Цоана и Мемфиса стали глупцами. \q Их самих обманули. Те самые вожди, которые должны сплачивать народ Египта, повели страну неверным путём.

ja.L: ツォアンの長たちは愚かになり、 \q メンフィスの長たちは欺かれた。 \q その部族の隅の石[である者たち]が、エジプトを迷わせた。
ja.B: ツォアンの高官たちは愚か者となり、 \q メンフィスの高官たちは惑わされている。 \q その部族を支える隅の石であるべき者たちが、エジプトを誤った方へ導いた。
ja.R: ツォアンとメンフィスの指導者たちは、愚か者になった。 \q 彼らも、だまされている。エジプトの人々を一つにまとめるはずの指導者たちが、国を間違った方向へ導いてしまった。

decisions.choice: Noph: Memphis
decisions.reason: Noph is the Hebrew name for Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt near the head of the delta (Jeremiah 2:16; Ezekiel 30:13).

decisions.choice: the cornerstone of her tribes: the leaders who should hold the people together
decisions.reason: "Corner" is used for leaders, the ones on whom a people rests (Judges 20:2; 1 Samuel 14:38). Egypt's chief men, who should support the nation, have led it astray.

decisions.choice: Memphis
decisions.reason: All levels use the familiar name Memphis for Noph.

decisions.choice: Menfis
decisions.reason: As the English does at every level, the Hebrew name Noph is given as the familiar name of the city, Menfis. The published Spanish form "Zoán" is kept for Zoan.

decisions.choice: "Memfisi" for Noph; "Soani" for Zoan
decisions.reason: The English names the city Memphis at every level; Swahili uses the common form "Memfisi".

decisions.choice: "Mem-phít"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "Noph" is the city of Memphis; as the English names it Memphis at every level, Vietnamese gives the familiar name "Mem-phít" rather than a transliteration of "Noph" that readers would not recognise. The same form is used in Jeremiah 2:16; 44:1; 46:14, 19.

decisions.choice: "멤피스" for Noph
decisions.reason: The English gives the city's known name at every level (meaning decision m1); Korean does the same, though older Korean Bibles transliterate the Hebrew "놉".

decisions.choice: Mênfis
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name Noph is given as "Mênfis", the city's familiar name, at every level, as the English says "Memphis"; "Nofe", the transliteration, stays in the meaning note's sense (m1).

decisions.choice: Noph as "ሜምፊስ" (new)
decisions.reason: The English names the city Memphis at every level (meaning decision m1); Amharic does the same with the usual Amharic form of the name.

decisions.choice: मेम्फ़िस
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Noph is Memphis (m1); Hindi follows the English at every level and uses the familiar name.

decisions.choice: "Мемфис"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Noph is Memphis (m1); the English gives the known name at every level, and the Russian does the same. Zoan keeps the form of Psalm 78:12, "Цоан".

decisions.choice: Noph "メンフィス" at every level, as the English (m1), the name Japanese readers know; pinnat shevateha "その部族の隅の石" (L, B), Readable "人々を一つにまとめるはずの指導者たち" (m2).
decisions.reason: The English gives Memphis at every level; the Hebrew form ノフ would need a note. Jeremiah and Ezekiel should keep メンフィス for Noph / Moph.
