records.literal_gloss: And will make himself known Yahweh to Egypt, and will know Egypt Yahweh in day the that, and they will serve [with] sacrifice and offering, and they will vow a vow to Yahweh and pay [it].

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will make {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} known to Egypt, and Egypt will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in that day, and they will serve with sacrifice and offering, and they will vow a vow to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and pay [it].
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will reveal {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will bring {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} sacrifices and grain offerings in worship; they will make vows to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and fulfill them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will show the Egyptians who {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is, and at that time they will know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They will worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} by offering sacrifices and gifts of grain. They will make promises to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and keep them.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se dará a conocer a Egipto, y Egipto conocerá {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en aquel día, y servirán con sacrificio y ofrenda, y harán voto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y [lo] cumplirán.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se revelará a Egipto, y aquel día Egipto conocerá {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Le ofrecerán sacrificios y ofrendas de grano en adoración; harán votos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y los cumplirán.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les mostrará a los egipcios quién es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y en ese tiempo conocerán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Lo adorarán ofreciendo sacrificios y ofrendas de grano. Le harán promesas {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y las cumplirán.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se fera connaître à l’Égypte, et l’Égypte connaîtra {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en ce jour-là, et ils serviront avec sacrifice et offrande, et ils feront des vœux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et [les] accompliront.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} se révélera à l’Égypte, et ce jour-là l’Égypte connaîtra {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adoreront avec des sacrifices et des offrandes de grain ; ils feront des vœux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et les accompliront.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} montrera aux Égyptiens qui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est, et en ce temps-là ils connaîtront {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adoreront en offrant des sacrifices et des offrandes de grain. Ils feront des promesses {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et ils les tiendront.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajijulisha kwa Misri, na Misri watamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika siku ile, nao watatumikia kwa dhabihu na sadaka, nao wataweka nadhiri kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuitimiza.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajifunua kwa Misri, na siku hiyo Misri watamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watamletea dhabihu na sadaka za nafaka katika ibada; wataweka nadhiri kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzitimiza.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaonyesha Wamisri {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni nani, na wakati huo watamjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watamwabudu kwa kutoa dhabihu na sadaka za nafaka. Wataahidi mambo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuyatimiza.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ tỏ mình cho Ai Cập biết, và trong ngày ấy Ai Cập sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; họ sẽ phụng thờ với sinh tế và lễ vật, sẽ hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giữ trọn [lời ấy].
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bày tỏ chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho Ai Cập, và vào ngày ấy Ai Cập sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ sẽ dâng sinh tế và lễ vật ngũ cốc mà thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; họ sẽ khấn hứa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và làm trọn lời khấn.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ cho dân Ai Cập biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là ai, và vào lúc ấy họ sẽ biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ sẽ thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng cách dâng sinh tế và lễ vật ngũ cốc. Họ sẽ hứa nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giữ lời.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트에 자신을 알리실 것이고, 그날에 이집트가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알 것이며, 그들이 희생 제물과 예물로 섬기고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 서원하고 갚을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트에 자신을 나타내실 것이니, 그날에 이집트가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알 것이다. 그들은 희생 제물과 곡식 제물을 드리며 그분을 섬기고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 서원하고 그것을 지킬 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트 사람들에게 그분이 누구신지 보여 주실 것이다. 그때에 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알게 될 것이다. 그들은 짐승 제물과 곡식 제물을 드리며 그분을 예배할 것이다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 약속하고 그 약속을 지킬 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se dará a conhecer ao Egito, e o Egito conhecerá {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} naquele dia, e servirão com sacrifício e oferta, e farão voto {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e [o] cumprirão.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} se revelará ao Egito, e naquele dia o Egito conhecerá {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Eles {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} adorarão com sacrifícios e ofertas de cereal; farão votos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e os cumprirão.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai mostrar aos egípcios quem {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é, e naquele dia eles vão conhecer {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vão adorá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} oferecendo sacrifícios e ofertas de cereal. Vão fazer promessas {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e cumpri-las.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱን ለግብፅ ያስታውቃል፤ ግብፅም በዚያ ቀን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ያውቃል፤ በመሥዋዕትና በእህል ቁርባንም ያመልካሉ፤ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስእለትን ይሳላሉ፤ ይፈጽሙታልም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱን ለግብፅ ይገልጣል፤ በዚያ ቀን ግብፅ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ታውቃለች። መሥዋዕትና የእህል ቁርባን አቅርበው ያመልኩታል፤ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ስእለት ይሳላሉ፤ ይፈጽሙታልም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ማንነቱን ለግብፃውያን ያሳያቸዋል፤ በዚያ ቀንም {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ያውቃሉ። መሥዋዕትና የእህል ስጦታ በማቅረብ ያመልኩታል። {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ቃል ይገባሉ፤ ቃላቸውንም ይጠብቃሉ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने आप को मिस्र पर प्रकट करेंगे, और उस दिन मिस्र {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को जानेगा, और वे बलिदान और भेंट के साथ सेवा करेंगे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मन्नत मानकर [उसे] पूरी करेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने आप को मिस्र पर प्रकट करेंगे, और उस दिन मिस्र {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को जान लेगा। वे आराधना में उनके लिए बलिदान और अन्नबलि लाएँगे; वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए मन्नतें मानेंगे और उन्हें पूरी करेंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मिस्रियों को दिखाएँगे कि वे कौन हैं, और उस दिन वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को जानेंगे। वे पशुओं के बलिदान और अनाज की भेंटें चढ़ाकर उनकी आराधना करेंगे। वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से वचन देंगे और उसे निभाएँगे।

ru.L: И откроет себя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Египту, и узнает Египет {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} в тот день, и будут служить с жертвой и приношением, и дадут обет {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и исполнят [его].
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} откроет себя Египту, и в тот день Египет познает {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Они будут поклоняться {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, принося жертвы и хлебные приношения; они будут давать обеты {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и исполнять их.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} покажет египтянам, кто {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}, и в тот день они узнают {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}. Они будут поклоняться {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}, принося жертвы и хлебные дары. Они будут давать обещания {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и исполнять их.

ja.L: そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエジプトにご自分を知らせ、エジプトはその日、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を知る。彼らはいけにえと穀物のささげ物をもって仕え、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に誓願を立てて、それを果たす。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエジプトにご自分を現され、その日、エジプトは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を知る。彼らはいけにえと穀物のささげ物をささげて礼拝し、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に誓願を立てて、それを果たす。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、エジプトの人々に、ご自分がだれであるかを示される。そのとき、彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を知るようになる。彼らは動物のいけにえや穀物のささげ物をささげて、その方を礼拝する。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に約束をして、それを守る。

decisions.choice: Egypt will know the LORD: what the exodus began, now completed
decisions.reason: At the exodus God acted "so that Egypt will know that I am the LORD" (Exodus 7:5; 14:4, 18), and Pharaoh had said "I do not know the LORD" (Exodus 5:2). Here Egypt comes to know him in worship.

decisions.choice: serve with sacrifice and offering: worship with animal and grain offerings
decisions.reason: "Serve" here means to worship. The second word is the usual term for the grain offering (Leviticus 2:1).

decisions.choice: "se fera connaître" (no setting)
alternatives: a deity setting on the reflexive
decisions.reason: The English has a deity_pronoun span on "himself"; the French reflexive "se" is a bound pronoun that does not take the setting.

decisions.choice: se dará a conhecer, se revelará (no span)
decisions.reason: Portuguese says "himself" with the reflexive "se", which is not a pronoun the deity setting capitalises; the English "himself" span has no counterpart here, while the object pronouns "o" and "lo" carry the setting.

decisions.choice: offering (minchah) as "የእህል ቁርባን"; vow "ስእለት"
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list.

decisions.choice: अन्नबलि
decisions.reason: Minhah here stands beside zebah as the grain offering (m2); Balanced uses the Pentateuch note's अन्नबलि, as the English "grain offerings"; Literal keeps the general भेंट, as the English "offering".

decisions.choice: 'avad zevach uminchah "いけにえと穀物のささげ物をもって仕え" (L), "……ささげて礼拝し" (B, R); minchah "穀物のささげ物" (LEV); nadar neder "誓願を立てて、それを果たす" (L, B), "約束をして、それを守る" (R).
decisions.reason: The offering words keep the forms of Leviticus; Readable uses the everyday word for a vow, as the English R does.

source.text: וְנָגַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם נָגֹ֣ף וְרָפ֑וֹא וְשָׁ֨בוּ֙ עַד־יְהוָ֔ה וְנֶעְתַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם וּרְפָאָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And will strike Yahweh Egypt, striking and healing, and they will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them and will heal them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Egypt, striking and healing, and they will return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be entreated by them and heal them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Egypt, striking and then healing. They will turn back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will listen to their prayers and heal them.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will strike Egypt with suffering, and then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will heal it. The Egyptians will turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will answer their prayers and make them well.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} herirá a Egipto, hiriendo y sanando, y se volverán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se dejará rogar por ellos y los sanará.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} golpeará a Egipto, golpeando y luego sanando. Se volverán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} escuchará sus oraciones y los sanará.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} castigará a Egipto con sufrimiento, y luego {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo sanará. Los egipcios se volverán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responderá a sus oraciones y los sanará.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera l’Égypte, frappant et guérissant, et ils reviendront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se laissera fléchir par eux et les guérira.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera l’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} frappera puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} guérira. Ils reviendront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écoutera leurs prières et les guérira.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} frappera l’Égypte par la souffrance, puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} la guérira. Les Égyptiens se tourneront vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondra à leurs prières et les guérira.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataipiga Misri, akipiga na kuponya, nao watamrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye atasihiwa nao na kuwaponya.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataipiga Misri, akipiga na kisha kuponya. Watamrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye atasikiliza maombi yao na kuwaponya.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataipiga Misri kwa mateso, kisha ataiponya. Wamisri watamgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajibu maombi yao na kuwafanya wapone.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh Ai Cập, vừa đánh vừa chữa lành; họ sẽ quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nhậm lời cầu xin của họ và chữa lành họ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đánh Ai Cập, đánh rồi lại chữa lành. Họ sẽ quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghe lời cầu xin của họ và chữa lành họ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giáng khổ đau trên Ai Cập, rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chữa lành nó. Dân Ai Cập sẽ quay về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đáp lời cầu nguyện của họ và chữa lành cho họ.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트를 치시되, 치시고 고치실 것이니, 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오면 그분께서 그들의 간구를 들으시고 그들을 고치실 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트를 치실 것이나, 치신 다음에는 고쳐 주실 것이다. 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오면, 그분께서 그들의 기도를 들으시고 그들을 낫게 하실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이집트를 고난으로 치실 것이다. 그러고 나서 그분께서 이집트를 고쳐 주실 것이다. 이집트 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아올 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 기도에 응답하시고 그들을 낫게 하실 것이다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ferirá o Egito, ferindo e curando, e eles voltarão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se deixará suplicar por eles e os curará.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ferirá o Egito, ferirá e depois curará. Eles se voltarão {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ouvirá as suas orações e os curará.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai castigar o Egito com sofrimento, e depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai curá-lo. Os egípcios vão se voltar {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai responder às suas orações e curá-los.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግብፅን ይመታል፤ እየመታ ይፈውሳል፤ እነርሱም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመለሳሉ፤ እርሱም ልመናቸውን ይሰማል፤ ይፈውሳቸዋልም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግብፅን ይመታል፤ ይመታል፤ ከዚያም ይፈውሳል። እነርሱም ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመለሳሉ፤ እርሱም ጸሎታቸውን ሰምቶ ይፈውሳቸዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ግብፅን በመከራ ይመታታል፤ ከዚያም ይፈውሳታል። ግብፃውያን ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይመለሳሉ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸሎታቸውን ይመልስላቸዋል፤ ይፈውሳቸዋልም።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मिस्र को मारेंगे, मारेंगे और चंगा करेंगे, और वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर लौटेंगे, और वे उनकी विनती सुनकर उन्हें चंगा करेंगे।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मिस्र को मारेंगे, मारेंगे और फिर चंगा करेंगे। वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर फिरेंगे, और वे उनकी प्रार्थनाएँ सुनकर उन्हें चंगा करेंगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मिस्र पर दुख लाएँगे, और फिर उसे चंगा करेंगे। मिस्री {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की ओर फिरेंगे। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उनकी प्रार्थनाओं का उत्तर देंगे और उन्हें चंगा करेंगे।

ru.L: И поразит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Египет, поражая и исцеляя, и обратятся они к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} внемлет их мольбам и исцелит их.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразит Египет — поразит и исцелит. Они обратятся к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} выслушает их молитвы и исцелит их.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} поразит Египет страданиями, а потом {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} исцелит его. Египтяне обратятся к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ответит на их молитвы и исцелит их.

ja.L: そして、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエジプトを打たれる。打って、そして癒やされる。彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰り、その方は彼らの願いを聞き入れて、彼らを癒やされる。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はエジプトを打たれる。打ち、そして癒やされる。彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰り、その方は彼らの祈りを聞いて、彼らを癒やされる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、エジプトに苦しみを与えて打たれる。それから、その国をいやされる。エジプトの人々は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に立ち帰る。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は彼らの祈りに答え、彼らを元気にしてくださる。

decisions.choice: striking and healing: the strike leads to healing
decisions.reason: Two infinitives follow the verb: God strikes in order to heal. The same pair is in Deuteronomy 32:39 and Hosea 6:1.

decisions.choice: return: turn back, repent
decisions.reason: The verb is the usual word for turning back to God. For Egypt it is a first turning to him.

decisions.choice: be entreated: let himself be moved by their prayer
decisions.reason: The verb means to let oneself be prayed to, and so to answer (Genesis 25:21; 2 Samuel 24:25).

decisions.choice: return (shuv) as "ይመለሳሉ"
decisions.reason: As the prophets' terms list for turning back to God.

decisions.choice: shuv "立ち帰る" (every level, as the Isaiah key word); ne'tar "願いを聞き入れて" (L), "祈りを聞いて" (B), "祈りに答え" (R); rafa' "癒やす" (L, B), "いやす / 元気にする" (R).
decisions.reason: The Isaiah forms for return and healing.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא תִּהְיֶ֨ה מְסִלָּ֤ה מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָה וּבָֽא־אַשּׁ֥וּר בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִצְרַ֣יִם בְּאַשּׁ֑וּר וְעָבְד֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם אֶת־אַשּֽׁוּר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: In day the that will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and will come Assyria into Egypt and Egypt into Assyria, and will serve Egypt with Assyria.

en.L: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt will serve with Assyria.
en.B: On that day a raised road will link Egypt with Assyria. Assyria will travel into Egypt, and Egypt into Assyria, and Egypt will join Assyria in worship.
en.R: At that time there will be a road between Egypt and Assyria. The people of Assyria will travel to Egypt, and the people of Egypt will travel to Assyria. The people of Egypt and Assyria will worship side by side.

es.L: En aquel día habrá una calzada de Egipto a Asiria, y Asiria entrará en Egipto, y Egipto en Asiria, y Egipto servirá con Asiria.
es.B: Aquel día una calzada unirá a Egipto con Asiria. Asiria viajará a Egipto, y Egipto a Asiria, y Egipto se unirá a Asiria en la adoración.
es.R: En ese tiempo habrá un camino entre Egipto y Asiria. La gente de Asiria viajará a Egipto, y la gente de Egipto viajará a Asiria. La gente de Egipto y de Asiria adorará junta.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, il y aura une route de l’Égypte vers l’Assyrie, et l’Assyrie viendra en Égypte, et l’Égypte en Assyrie, et l’Égypte servira avec l’Assyrie.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, une route surélevée reliera l’Égypte à l’Assyrie. L’Assyrie ira en Égypte, et l’Égypte en Assyrie, et l’Égypte rendra un culte avec l’Assyrie.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, il y aura une route entre l’Égypte et l’Assyrie. Les Assyriens iront en Égypte, et les Égyptiens iront en Assyrie. Les Égyptiens et les Assyriens adoreront Dieu côte à côte.

sw.L: Katika siku ile kutakuwa na njia kuu kutoka Misri hadi Ashuru, na Ashuru ataingia Misri, na Misri ataingia Ashuru, na Misri watatumikia pamoja na Ashuru.
sw.B: Siku hiyo barabara kuu iliyoinuliwa itaiunganisha Misri na Ashuru. Waashuru watasafiri kuingia Misri, na Wamisri kuingia Ashuru, na Misri itaungana na Ashuru katika ibada.
sw.R: Wakati huo kutakuwa na barabara kati ya Misri na Ashuru. Watu wa Ashuru watasafiri kwenda Misri, na watu wa Misri watasafiri kwenda Ashuru. Watu wa Misri na Ashuru wataabudu pamoja bega kwa bega.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy sẽ có một đường cái lớn từ Ai Cập đến A-si-ri; A-si-ri sẽ vào Ai Cập, Ai Cập vào A-si-ri, và Ai Cập sẽ cùng A-si-ri phụng thờ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, một đường cái lớn sẽ nối Ai Cập với A-si-ri. Người A-si-ri sẽ đến Ai Cập, người Ai Cập sẽ đến A-si-ri, và Ai Cập sẽ cùng A-si-ri thờ phượng.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, sẽ có một con đường nối Ai Cập với A-si-ri. Dân A-si-ri sẽ đi đến Ai Cập, và dân Ai Cập sẽ đi đến A-si-ri. Dân Ai Cập và dân A-si-ri sẽ cùng nhau thờ phượng.

ko.L: 그날에 이집트에서 앗시리아로 가는 큰길이 있어서, 앗시리아가 이집트로 들어오고 이집트가 앗시리아로 들어갈 것이며, 이집트가 앗시리아와 함께 섬길 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 이집트에서 앗시리아로 이어지는 큰길이 생길 것이다. 앗시리아 사람들은 이집트로 오고 이집트 사람들은 앗시리아로 가며, 이집트 사람들이 앗시리아 사람들과 함께 예배할 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 이집트와 앗시리아 사이에 길이 생길 것이다. 앗시리아 사람들은 이집트로 오가고, 이집트 사람들은 앗시리아로 오갈 것이다. 이집트 사람들과 앗시리아 사람들이 나란히 하나님을 예배할 것이다.

pt.L: Naquele dia haverá uma estrada do Egito até a Assíria, e a Assíria virá ao Egito, e o Egito à Assíria, e o Egito servirá com a Assíria.
pt.B: Naquele dia uma estrada elevada ligará o Egito à Assíria. A Assíria irá ao Egito, e o Egito à Assíria, e o Egito se unirá à Assíria na adoração.
pt.R: Naquele dia haverá uma estrada entre o Egito e a Assíria. O povo da Assíria vai viajar para o Egito, e o povo do Egito vai viajar para a Assíria. O povo do Egito e o da Assíria vão adorar a Deus lado a lado.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን ከግብፅ ወደ አሦር አውራ ጎዳና ይሆናል፤ አሦርም ወደ ግብፅ፣ ግብፅም ወደ አሦር ይገባሉ፤ ግብፅም ከአሦር ጋር ያመልካል።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን ግብፅን ከአሦር ጋር የሚያገናኝ ከፍ ያለ መንገድ ይኖራል። አሦራውያን ወደ ግብፅ፣ ግብፃውያንም ወደ አሦር ይሄዳሉ፤ ግብፃውያንም ከአሦራውያን ጋር አብረው ያመልካሉ።
am.R: በዚያ ቀን በግብፅና በአሦር መካከል መንገድ ይኖራል። የአሦር ሰዎች ወደ ግብፅ፣ የግብፅ ሰዎችም ወደ አሦር ይሄዳሉ። የግብፅና የአሦር ሰዎች ጎን ለጎን ሆነው ያመልካሉ።

hi.L: उस दिन मिस्र से अश्शूर तक एक राजमार्ग होगा, और अश्शूर मिस्र में आएगा, और मिस्र अश्शूर में, और मिस्र अश्शूर के साथ सेवा करेगा।
hi.B: उस दिन एक ऊँचा बनाया हुआ मार्ग मिस्र को अश्शूर से जोड़ेगा। अश्शूर मिस्र में आया-जाया करेगा, और मिस्र अश्शूर में, और मिस्र अश्शूर के साथ मिलकर आराधना करेगा।
hi.R: उस दिन मिस्र और अश्शूर के बीच एक सड़क होगी। अश्शूर के लोग मिस्र आएँगे, और मिस्र के लोग अश्शूर जाएँगे। मिस्र और अश्शूर के लोग साथ-साथ आराधना करेंगे।

ru.L: В тот день будет большая дорога из Египта в Ассирию, и придёт Ассирия в Египет, и Египет в Ассирию, и будет Египет служить вместе с Ассирией.
ru.B: В тот день насыпная дорога соединит Египет с Ассирией. Ассирия будет приходить в Египет, а Египет — в Ассирию, и Египет будет вместе с Ассирией поклоняться Богу.
ru.R: В тот день будет дорога между Египтом и Ассирией. Ассирийцы будут ездить в Египет, а египтяне — в Ассирию. Египтяне и ассирийцы будут вместе поклоняться Богу.

ja.L: その日、エジプトからアッシリアへ大路ができ、アッシリアはエジプトに、エジプトはアッシリアに来る。そして、エジプトはアッシリアと共に仕える。
ja.B: その日、盛り土をした大路がエジプトとアッシリアを結ぶ。アッシリアはエジプトへ、エジプトはアッシリアへと行き来し、エジプトはアッシリアと共に礼拝する。
ja.R: そのとき、エジプトとアッシリアの間に道ができる。アッシリアの人々はエジプトへ行き、エジプトの人々はアッシリアへ行く。エジプトとアッシリアの人々は、一緒に神を礼拝する。

decisions.choice: a highway: a raised road built up for travel
decisions.reason: The word is used of the road on which God's people return in 11:16 and 40:3. Here the road joins two enemies who had fought over the land between them.

decisions.choice: Egypt will serve with Assyria: they will worship together
decisions.reason: The small word between the names can mean "with" or can mark the object. Read as "with", it means the two nations worship together, as in verse 21. Read as the object, it would mean "Egypt will serve Assyria", but verses 24-25 speak of the three nations as equals.

decisions.choice: "Egypt will serve with Assyria" as "ከአሦር ጋር ያመልካል" (will worship) at Literal
decisions.reason: The verb ʿavad here is service in worship (meaning decision m2); "ያገለግላል" alone could read as serving Assyria as a subject people.

decisions.choice: "служить вместе с Ассирией" (L); "поклоняться Богу" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Egypt will worship together with Assyria (m2), not serve it; Russian "служить" alone could read as serving Assyria, so Balanced and Readable say whom they worship.

decisions.choice: mesillah "大路" (L), "盛り土をした大路" (B), "道" (R); 'avdu 'et "共に仕える" (L), "共に礼拝する" (B, R), the English reading (m2, footnoted).
alternatives: "エジプトはアッシリアに仕える"
decisions.reason: The verb could mean that Egypt serves Assyria; the English reads worship together and footnotes it, and Japanese follows.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלִ֣ישִׁיָּ֔ה לְמִצְרַ֖יִם וּלְאַשּׁ֑וּר בְּרָכָ֖ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: In day the that will be Israel a third to Egypt and to Assyria, a blessing in [the] midst of the earth,

en.L: In that day Israel will be a third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth,
en.B: On that day Israel will make a third with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the middle of the earth,
en.R: At that time Israel will join Egypt and Assyria as the third of these nations. Israel will be a blessing to the whole world.

es.L: En aquel día Israel será tercero con Egipto y con Asiria, una bendición en medio de la tierra,
es.B: Aquel día Israel será el tercero junto a Egipto y Asiria, una bendición en medio de la tierra,
es.R: En ese tiempo Israel se unirá a Egipto y a Asiria como la tercera de esas naciones. Israel será una bendición para todo el mundo.

fr.L: En ce jour-là, Israël sera un troisième avec l’Égypte et avec l’Assyrie, une bénédiction au milieu de la terre,
fr.B: Ce jour-là, Israël fera un troisième avec l’Égypte et l’Assyrie, une bénédiction au milieu de la terre,
fr.R: En ce temps-là, Israël se joindra à l’Égypte et à l’Assyrie comme la troisième de ces nations. Israël sera une bénédiction pour le monde entier.

sw.L: Katika siku ile Israeli atakuwa wa tatu pamoja na Misri na Ashuru, baraka katikati ya dunia,
sw.B: Siku hiyo Israeli atakuwa wa tatu pamoja na Misri na Ashuru, baraka katikati ya dunia,
sw.R: Wakati huo Israeli ataungana na Misri na Ashuru kama taifa la tatu kati yao. Israeli atakuwa baraka kwa ulimwengu wote.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ là [nước] thứ ba cùng với Ai Cập và A-si-ri, là nguồn phước ở giữa đất,
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ là nước thứ ba cùng với Ai Cập và A-si-ri, là một nguồn phước giữa thế gian,
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ cùng với Ai Cập và A-si-ri làm thành ba nước. Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ là nguồn phước cho cả thế giới.

ko.L: 그날에 이스라엘이 이집트와 앗시리아와 더불어 셋째가 되어, 땅 가운데에 복이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 이스라엘은 이집트와 앗시리아와 함께 세 나라 가운데 하나가 되어, 온 세상 한가운데에서 복이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 이스라엘은 이집트와 앗시리아와 함께 세 번째 나라가 될 것이다. 이스라엘은 온 세상에 복이 될 것이다.

pt.L: Naquele dia Israel será o terceiro com o Egito e com a Assíria, uma bênção no meio da terra,
pt.B: Naquele dia Israel será o terceiro, junto com o Egito e a Assíria, uma bênção no meio da terra,
pt.R: Naquele dia Israel vai se juntar ao Egito e à Assíria como a terceira dessas nações. Israel será uma bênção para o mundo inteiro.

am.L: በዚያ ቀን እስራኤል ከግብፅና ከአሦር ጋር ሦስተኛ ይሆናል፤ በምድርም መካከል በረከት ይሆናል፤
am.B: በዚያ ቀን እስራኤል ከግብፅና ከአሦር ጋር ሦስተኛ ይሆናል፤ በምድር መካከልም በረከት ይሆናል፤
am.R: በዚያ ቀን እስራኤል ከግብፅና ከአሦር ጋር ሦስተኛ ሕዝብ ሆኖ ይቀላቀላል። እስራኤል ለዓለም ሁሉ በረከት ይሆናል።

hi.L: उस दिन इस्राएल मिस्र और अश्शूर के साथ तीसरा होगा, पृथ्वी के बीच में एक आशीष,
hi.B: उस दिन इस्राएल मिस्र और अश्शूर के साथ तीसरा बनेगा, पृथ्वी के बीचों-बीच एक आशीष,
hi.R: उस दिन इस्राएल तीसरे देश के रूप में मिस्र और अश्शूर के साथ जुड़ जाएगा। इस्राएल सारे संसार के लिए आशीष का कारण होगा।

ru.L: В тот день Израиль будет третьим с Египтом и с Ассирией, благословением посреди земли,
ru.B: В тот день Израиль станет третьим вместе с Египтом и Ассирией, благословением посреди земли,
ru.R: В тот день Израиль станет третьим народом вместе с Египтом и Ассирией. Израиль будет благословением для всего мира.

ja.L: その日、イスラエルはエジプトとアッシリアと共に第三のものとなり、地の真ん中で祝福となる、
ja.B: その日、イスラエルは、エジプトとアッシリアに並ぶ第三の国となり、地の真ん中で祝福となる、
ja.R: そのとき、イスラエルは、エジプトとアッシリアに加わって、三つ目の国となる。イスラエルは、全世界にとって祝福となる。

decisions.choice: a blessing in the midst of the earth: the promise to Abraham fulfilled
decisions.reason: God promised Abraham, "You will be a blessing", and that all the families of the earth would be blessed through him (Genesis 12:2-3). Israel stands between the two great powers as the source of blessing.

decisions.choice: a third: one of three, an equal partner
decisions.reason: Israel, small and caught between Egypt and Assyria, will be the third member of a group of three.

decisions.choice: a blessing to the whole world
decisions.reason: Readable says "to the whole world" for "in the midst of the earth": Israel's blessing reaches the nations around it.

decisions.choice: Verse 24 closes with its own verb ("복이 될 것이다"), and verse 25 continues with "만군의 ... 복을 주시며"
alternatives: leaving verse 24 open as the English does
decisions.reason: Korean cannot leave the noun of verse 24 waiting for the relative clause of verse 25; each verse closes on its own verb, and verse 25 restates who blesses them.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on into 19:25 ("whom the LORD of hosts has blessed"): Literal and Balanced end with "、", and 19:25 takes up the three nations again as "それ / これら / 彼ら", so the relative clause becomes a following clause in Japanese order.
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot put the relative clause after its noun; the content of each verse stays in its own record.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרֲכ֛וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּר֨וּךְ עַמִּ֜י מִצְרַ֗יִם וּמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדַי֙ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְנַחֲלָתִ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: whom has blessed him Yahweh of hosts, saying, blessed [be] my people Egypt, and [the] work of my hands Assyria, and my inheritance Israel.

en.L: whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has blessed, saying, "Blessed be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people Egypt, and the work of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands Assyria, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} inheritance Israel."
en.B: whom {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has blessed with these words: "May Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, be blessed, and Assyria, which {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands have made, and Israel, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} own inheritance."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies has blessed them and said, "I bless Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people. I bless Assyria, the nation that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hands made. I bless Israel, the people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

es.L: a la cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha bendecido, diciendo: «Bendito sea Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y Asiria, obra de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos, e Israel, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} heredad».
es.B: a la cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos ha bendecido con estas palabras: «Bendito sea Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, y Asiria, que hicieron {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos, e Israel, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} propia heredad».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos los ha bendecido y ha dicho: «Bendigo a Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo. Bendigo a Asiria, la nación que hicieron {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} manos. Bendigo a Israel, el pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece».

fr.L: que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a béni, disant : « Bénie soit l’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et l’Assyrie, l’œuvre de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains, et Israël, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} héritage. »
fr.B: que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a béni en ces termes : « Bénie soit l’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et l’Assyrie, que {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains ont faite, et Israël, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} héritage. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées les a bénis et a dit : « Je bénis l’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. Je bénis l’Assyrie, la nation que {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} mains ont faite. Je bénis Israël, le peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient. »

sw.L: ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amewabariki, akisema, "Wabarikiwe watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Misri, na kazi ya mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} Ashuru, na urithi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Israeli."
sw.B: ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amewabariki kwa maneno haya: "Misri, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, wabarikiwe, na Ashuru, ambao mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} imewafanya, na Israeli, urithi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mwenyewe."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amewabariki na kusema, "Ninawabariki Wamisri, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Ninawabariki Waashuru, taifa ambalo mikono {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ililifanya. Ninawabariki Waisraeli, watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}."

vi.L: là [những nước] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã ban phước mà phán: "Phước cho Ai Cập, dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cho A-si-ri, công việc của tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, cơ nghiệp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: là những nước {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã ban phước bằng những lời này: "Nguyện Ai Cập, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, được phước, cùng A-si-ri, công trình của tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và Y-sơ-ra-ên, cơ nghiệp riêng của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã ban phước cho họ và phán: "Ta ban phước cho Ai Cập, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta ban phước cho A-si-ri, dân tộc tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tạo nên. Ta ban phước cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 복을 주시며 말씀하셨다. "나의 백성 이집트와 내 손으로 지은 앗시리아와 나의 유업 이스라엘에게 복이 있을 것이다."
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 복을 내리시며 이렇게 말씀하셨다. "내 백성 이집트야, 복을 받아라. 내 손으로 지은 앗시리아야, 내 소유인 이스라엘아, 복을 받아라."
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들에게 복을 주시며 말씀하셨다. "내가 내 백성 이집트에게 복을 준다. 내 손으로 만든 나라 앗시리아에게 복을 준다. 나에게 속한 백성 이스라엘에게 복을 준다."

pt.L: a quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos abençoou, dizendo: "Bendito [seja] o Egito, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e a Assíria, obra das {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos, e Israel, {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} herança."
pt.B: a quem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos abençoou com estas palavras: "Seja abençoado o Egito, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e a Assíria, que as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos fizeram, e Israel, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} própria herança."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos os abençoou e disse: "Eu abençoo o Egito, o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. Eu abençoo a Assíria, a nação que as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} mãos fizeram. Eu abençoo Israel, o povo que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertence."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ብሎ ባርኳቸዋልና፦ «ሕዝቤ ግብፅ፣ የእጆቼም ሥራ አሦር፣ ርስቴም እስራኤል የተባረኩ ይሁኑ።»

am.R: የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ባርኳቸዋል፤ እንዲህም ብሏል፦ «ሕዝቤ ግብፅን እባርካለሁ። እጆቼ የሠሩትን ሕዝብ አሦርን እባርካለሁ። የእኔ የሆነውን ሕዝብ እስራኤልን እባርካለሁ።»

hi.B: जिन्हें सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने इन शब्दों से आशीष दी है: "धन्य हो मिस्र, मेरी प्रजा, और अश्शूर, जिसे मेरे हाथों ने बनाया, और इस्राएल, मेरा अपना निज भाग।"
hi.R: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उन्हें आशीष दी है और कहा है, "मैं मिस्र को आशीष देता हूँ, जो मेरी प्रजा है। मैं अश्शूर को आशीष देता हूँ, वह देश जिसे मेरे हाथों ने बनाया। मैं इस्राएल को आशीष देता हूँ, वह प्रजा जो मेरी अपनी है।"

ja.B: 万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、これらを祝福してこう言われる。「わたしの民エジプト、わたしの手が造ったアッシリア、わたしの嗣業イスラエルが、祝福されるように。」
ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、彼らを祝福して言われた。「わたしは、わたしの民エジプトを祝福する。わたしの手で造った国アッシリアを祝福する。わたしのものである民イスラエルを祝福する。」

decisions.choice: whom the LORD has blessed: the three nations together
alternatives: which the LORD has blessed (the earth)
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular, "has blessed him" or "it". It may refer to the earth, to Israel, or to the three nations as one people. The blessing that follows names all three. The verb is past in form, as prophets often speak of what is certain to happen.

decisions.choice: my people ... the work of my hands ... my inheritance: Israel's titles given to the nations
decisions.reason: "My people" (Exodus 3:7) and "the work of my hands" (60:21; 64:7) are titles of Israel, and Israel is God's own inheritance (Deuteronomy 32:9). Here God gives these titles to Egypt and Assyria as well, while Israel is still called his inheritance.

decisions.choice: I bless
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and repeats "I bless" for each nation. "The people who belong to me" explains "my inheritance".

decisions.choice: Verse 25 begins a new sentence ("... ባርኳቸዋልና") rather than a relative clause hanging on verse 24
decisions.reason: Amharic would have to move "whom the LORD has blessed" in front of verse 24; a new sentence keeps the verses in order. Israel's inheritance is "ርስት", as the Joshua-Samuel list.

decisions.choice: मेरा निज भाग
decisions.reason: Nahalah, God's inheritance, is निज भाग, as the Pentateuch uses it for Israel; the three titles, once Israel's alone, are given to the nations (m2).

decisions.choice: barukh "祝福されよ" (L), "祝福されるように" (B), "わたしは……祝福する" (R, as the English R "I bless"); nachalati "わたしの嗣業" (L, B), "わたしのものである民" (R), as Deuteronomy.
decisions.reason: Israel's titles are given to the nations (m2); the Deuteronomy word for God's inheritance is kept at the formal levels.
